(My Best Recomp Lessons), 2022-08](https://youtu.be/9WA6eQODjHQ?t=690)). Later view: 14-15%.
- **Maintenance as a summer tool.** Since 2024 he cycles winter bulk / summer maintenance-recomp ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=7914); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=4379)). That replaces both his 2020 "no cycles" stance and his 2023 continuous-bulk plan ([Wild Man Training (Hypertrophy Log #0), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/P7ADeDVghxg?t=1411)).

**Contradictions**

- **Dirty vs slow bulk muscle gain.** He claims dirty bulking builds less muscle because junk lacks protein ([The dangers of dirty bulking (and why I don't recommend it), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/a02c10s3Pjk?t=256)) (2020). He also claims the muscle difference is "negligibly small, if it exists" ([Crazy bulks： secret for INSANE gains?, 2021-11](https://youtu.be/-T8qWCI4_No?t=524)) (2021).
- **Target bodyweight.** Never set a goal bodyweight ([Don't fall for the bulking meme, 2022-11](https://youtu.be/h7D6CB4p1oU?t=1708); [My Nightmare Bulk (Story Time), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/XK9KjVP-5Wo?t=691)). But he praised Hamza's 180 lb target as "good nuanced advice" ([How BAD is Hamza's Fitness Advice? (5 BIGGEST Reasons You Can’t Gain Muscle), 2023-01](https://youtu.be/h3U30oRVrMU?t=379)) (2023-01).
- **Tall lifters.** Slow patient bulking (2023-12) ([Giants DO Exist (Tom Haviland), 2023-12](https://youtu.be/hEuy__sCbZA?t=1326)) vs aggressive bulking justified (2024-12) ([So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=8764)).
- **Years spent bulking.** "Bulked 14 of his 15 years" ([Story Time (Top 10 NH stories), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/TvKzeUKgZcY?t=258)) vs a 3-year maintenance at 210 lb ([Building Muscles AND Losing Fat WITHOUT Gaining Weight? (My Best Recomp Lessons), 2022-08](https://youtu.be/9WA6eQODjHQ)).
- **Recomp vs bulk+cut efficiency.** Similar or slightly less long-term ([Building Muscles AND Losing Fat WITHOUT Gaining Weight? (My Best Recomp Lessons), 2022-08](https://youtu.be/9WA6eQODjHQ?t=315)) vs losing dirty-bulk fat by recomp ~15x slower than a slow bulk ([Crazy bulks： secret for INSANE gains?, 2021-11](https://youtu.be/-T8qWCI4_No?t=1209)).
- **His ideal body fat.** 10-12% advised for an "otter mode" look (2023-03) ([Is THIS the most attractive body type? (Ottermode Physique), 2023-03](https://youtu.be/HOgwZO70z_M?t=315)) vs 15-16% best for himself in the same video ([Is THIS the most attractive body type? (Ottermode Physique), 2023-03](https://youtu.be/HOgwZO70z_M?t=1134)). Likely physique-specific, not a real conflict.

## Cardio

**Changed over time**

- **No cardio → cardio advocate.** 2020-2021: he "does not do cardio in the conventional way", hadn't done cardio in 3 years, did all cardio with weights and never used ellipticals or steppers. Cardio was "not necessary", and 30 min lifting beats 30 min cardio ([The importance of cardio for bodybuilding & overall health, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ckDmNEFcwW8); [The hypertrophy series： surpassing cardiovascular limitations, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/LCpa0h89TJM?t=380); [Building work capacity with cardio specificity, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/BBqiphYfqMA?t=504); [The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07](https://youtu.be/8ELQ2XZgpls?t=1394)). From 2023-11: cardio is "S tier", 5-15 min after every session, and it "makes you a better bodybuilder". He now does the stair machine, treadmill miles and carries ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=1952); [Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6yW3GSskl8g?t=887); [How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=1197)). Later view: do cardio.
- **Calories framing.** 2020: cardio kills gains indirectly through calories, and skinny lifters should avoid it ([Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/6sFaB3rAY1A?t=2008); [ANIME WORKOUTS - Would Jack Hanma's Transformation in Grappler Baki be possible , 2020-12](https://youtu.be/WyxeMHovPJ8?t=125)). 2024: good cardio boosts gains ([The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=189)).
- **Leg-day cardio.** 2022: avoid intense leg cardio on leg days ([Hypertrophy Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/9y2s6kyFkPc?t=2128)). 2024-12: hard cardio on top of leg training boosts recovery and conditioning ([How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=1134)). Later view: it's fine.
- **Stepper/jump rope.** 2020: prefer stepper or jump rope over treadmill ([The importance of cardio for bodybuilding & overall health, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ckDmNEFcwW8?t=441)). 2021: never steppers ([Building work capacity with cardio specificity, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/BBqiphYfqMA?t=504)). 2024: StairMaster is S tier and jump rope is poor for bodybuilders ([The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=1769); [The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=757)).
- **Running.** 2020: uphill running "unmatched" for cardio ([4 days Upper Lower program review, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/ZKgM-tX_ODU?t=62)). 2024: running C tier, long distance D ([The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=316); [The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=379)). Sprints and fartlek stay highly rated.

**Contradictions**

- **Running surface vs running.** He says best cardio is outdoors on soft ground (2020) ([The importance of cardio for bodybuilding & overall health, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ckDmNEFcwW8?t=503)), yet he runs on a self-powered treadmill and ranks the treadmill D tier (2024) ([So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=569); [The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=693)). The manual treadmill is his exception ([This is what the Perfect Physique looks like (Physical 100 Season 2), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/APmM-moU9z8?t=63)).
- **Weights-only cardio.** "He does not recommend that people do cardio only through weight training" ([The importance of cardio for bodybuilding & overall health, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ckDmNEFcwW8?t=691)) vs, in the same era, he does all his cardio with weights and says high-rep work and giant sets "already provide enough" conditioning ([Building work capacity with cardio specificity, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/BBqiphYfqMA?t=504); [Doggcrapp Training review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/A55c7v1yMn4?t=875)).

## Culture manga

**Changed over time**

- **Goal physique:** adult Gon in 2020 ([Natural Hypertrophy： What I picture as my ideal physique, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/4Js7OkiuuKU)). A Zodd/Guts/Uvogin/Toguro mix in 2022, with Guts "too much shoulder" ([My Program to go BERSERKER MODE (BODYBUILDING GOAL PHYSIQUE), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/itnjfi6RYtY?t=126)). In 2023 he describes an explicitly unreachable anime body as the point of striving ([Build your Dream Physique with Image Training ｜ The Power of Placebo & Visualiza, 2023-02](https://youtu.be/UWr5TQVT63g?t=814)). This is a refinement, not a reversal.
- **Guts as a model:** in 2021 Golden Age Guts was a physique target ([Can you look like Guts from Berserk in real life?, 2021-12](https://youtu.be/bqcRtC3bbK8?t=78)). In 2023 he warns against emulating Guts's psychological traits (the physique is still fine; a Guts program is offered in 2024) ([You are not Guts (The Berserk Trauma), 2023-10](https://youtu.be/SS5uAU1rcEo?t=710); [Swinging a sword WON'T make you jacked, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/29XrRmOrCMs?t=1320)).

**Contradictions**

- **Favourite film:** Star Wars Episode III "of all time" (2021) ([Natural Q&A #8, 2021-10](https://youtu.be/ilGY8qFjuxI?t=2888)) vs Watchmen (2022) ([I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/q1XhaAN9M5k?t=1752)).
- **Favourite fiction:** a French YA fantasy series ranked with Lord of the Rings (2022) ([I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/q1XhaAN9M5k?t=1688)) vs Dune as favourite book of all time (2024) ([The Philosophy of Dune, 2024-03](https://youtu.be/-PDjwKZQVLw)).
- **Physique role models:** he "never looked up to any physique" and was his own standard (2020) ([Why your Genetics don't matter, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/xCzoFKSPkIc?t=877)) vs adult Gon as his goal physique the same year ([Natural Hypertrophy： What I picture as my ideal physique, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/4Js7OkiuuKU)).
- **Baki's height:** given as 5'2" ([A Shonen rewriting of David and Goliath： Baki vs Hanayama in Grappler Baki, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/V6YDUJZ2E64?t=62)) vs 5'6" ([MUSCLE MANGA - Ohma ＂The Ashura＂ Tokita's Physique in Kengan Ashura (part. 1), 2021-05](https://youtu.be/qyIeSz_D9UQ?t=64)) (fictional stats; minor).

## Equipment home gym

**Changed over time**

- **Home vs commercial gym:** in 2020-2021 he said owning your gym unlocks progress, commercial gyms are dying, and an elite physique eventually needs a personal gym ([Benefits of having a home gym： King in your own castle, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/rDfa3uMzwMQ?t=254); [Swole shaming is real, BIGot, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/eKBDacpRYSU?t=1071); [Buy a home gym, escape the Gestapo, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/h21r7Mrxfo8?t=123)). From 2023 to 2025 he calls commercial gyms optimal for building muscle, trains about 50/50, joined a gym for delts and triceps, and recommends cheap uncrowded gyms ([Mountain Training Arc (100K SPECIAL), 2023-08](https://youtu.be/zuvTDBbAWN8?t=442); [Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=440); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=1460); [You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/0O0nG2jLadU?t=761)). The later view is the hybrid one.
- **Machines:** he was a "barbell purist" in 2020 who didn't need guided machines ([Should home gym owners invest in machines?, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/8j33uH5-RzA?t=191)). In 2022-2024 he rates good machines, Smith machines and cables highly (converging presses may beat the bench) ([The ULTIMATE Chest Exercises Tier-List (Gorilla-tier to A cup-tier), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/cUkWvnY8AJI?t=2693); [Hypertrophy training is CANCELLED, 2024-06](https://youtu.be/jUMmu583w34?t=800); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=1460)).
- **Shoes:** in 2020 he wore heeled lifting shoes for all squats ([What shoes should you wear for lifting? ( Flat sole vs high heel), 2020-01](https://youtu.be/4S7JYYVqIEg)). In 2024 he squats flat with no difference and keeps lifting shoes only for high-bar ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=260)).
- **Sleeves/wraps:** in 2020 they added poundage for almost anyone ([The utility of lifting gear, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/f_ElXUd7LHE?t=183)). In 2021 they were mostly placebo, 10-20 lb ([The form p＊lice is under arrest, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/GH8tqzGTgH8?t=4324); [Injury Q&A #4, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/9kIIW251uiI?t=1766)).
- **Slingshot:** he reviewed it positively in 2020-2021 ([Should you buy this instead of a slingshot? (Bench daddy review), 2020-01](https://youtu.be/Pr6to3cPR1g?t=42); [Hypertrophy benefits of the Slingshot, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/3z75cYOdZ74)). In 2025 he no longer uses it and is selling it ([You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/0O0nG2jLadU?t=132)).
- **Adjustable dumbbells:** in 2020 they made sense vs fixed sets ([Rogue DB-10 DB-15 loadable dumbbells review - Best on the market?, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/GkU58YBoWqQ)). In 2024 they're a "trap" unless used ≥3x/week ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=9430)).
- **Neck harness:** in 2022 plates and bands were enough for an aesthetic neck ([Most UNDERRATED Muscle for Aesthetics (TAKE THE NECK PILL), 2022-11](https://youtu.be/1U5cgUdos88?t=379)). In 2023 a harness is far better and he regrets not buying one sooner ([HELP! I'm getting too BIG (Hypertrophy Log #5), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/6YC_gmRNhPo?t=1261)).
- **Fat grips:** in 2020 he wasn't using them ("beta take") ([Fat grips training for forearm hypertrophy, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/m-DWvBP_ncU)). In 2023 they're A tier ([The ULTIMATE Forearm Exercises Tier-List (Popeye-tier to Skeletor-tier), 2023-03](https://youtu.be/iPtxiNtBY-M?t=1763)).
- **Kettlebells:** in 2022 any resistance was valid ([Hypertrophy Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/9y2s6kyFkPc?t=563)). In 2024 they're inferior for hypertrophy ([Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=8040)).
- **Timing to build:** in 2020 he said don't build during the COVID crisis ([Benefits of having a home gym： King in your own castle, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/rDfa3uMzwMQ)). In 2021 it was a good time because prices had fallen ([Buy a home gym, escape the Gestapo, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/h21r7Mrxfo8)) (context change, not a reversal).

**Contradictions**

- **Used gear value:** buying a home gym is like owning a house because you can resell, and even overpriced gear saves money long term ([Save your money, buy a home gym, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/4mW1c9W4QRk?t=379); [Save your money, buy a home gym, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/4mW1c9W4QRk?t=444)). Elsewhere, used gear loses value and isn't an investment like stocks ([Fake Merc Character Study (part. 9)： Grifter by day, Porker by night, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/U1zVxzMVM2E?t=3179)). In the same video he also calls the membership-savings argument weak ([Save your money, buy a home gym, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/4mW1c9W4QRk)).
- **Cheap used dumbbells:** in 2022 cheap second-hand DBs feel terrible and can cause tendonitis ([💸 Revolutionary Money-Saving Hack (MUST-HAVE for ALL Lifters!), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/BayeNJ0NUTE?t=62)). In 2024 he says buy used dumbbells from closing gyms or private sellers ([BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=3245)) (probably junk vs gym-grade, but not stated).
- **Sneakers:** in 2020 he says avoid sneakers/Jordans for lifting ([What shoes should you wear for lifting? ( Flat sole vs high heel), 2020-01](https://youtu.be/4S7JYYVqIEg?t=380)). Also in 2020 he calls LeBron lifestyle sneakers his favorite lifting shoes ([10 000$ Home Gym Tour - 10k subs special, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/SbPaZ5giUNs?t=1688)).
- **His platform cost:** ~$500 for 16x8 ft (Feb 2020) ([Equipment you can afford to go cheap on for your home gym, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/Lg0FY5wzMqw?t=248)) vs $800-900 for 16x9 ft (Dec 2020) ([10 000$ Home Gym Tour - 10k subs special, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/SbPaZ5giUNs?t=123)).
- **Months of cold:** 8 months at ~20 °F ([Everything wrong with Online Masculinity and Modern Bodybuilding all in one meat, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/5ANLeP4QvX8?t=2962)) vs ~6 months at 20-30 °F ([Natural Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/eC9Srr3ZygE?t=2171)), both 2022.

## Exercise selection

**Changed over time**

- **Deadlift → RDL.** 2020-21: deadlifts are mandatory, ~85% of his back thickness, the best whole-body builder, floor pulls never optional ([FREE 4/5 days Gentleman split (part. 1), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/cGzlMRCxvxo?t=1844); [Hypertrophy Q&A #4, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/ZScs2L9rero?t=695); [Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/GClcGq2tIDU?t=753)). 2022: the deadlift is an accessory to the RDL ([Top 8 WORST Lifts for Hypertrophy (and why you should still do them), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/bPUrJ3CSqEA?t=256)). 2023-24: RDL is king, the deadlift is B/C tier, an "energy vampire" done ~once a month, and bodybuilders don't need it ([Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=944); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=8211); [The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1194)). Later view: RDL first.
- **Bench → dips/ring push-ups.** 2020: bench is the best horizontal press by risk/reward; he wouldn't recommend dips over bench ([Response to Husaka - CHEST - Bench vs Ring Push Ups, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/K4UBm1dV6WM?t=313); [Response to Husaka - CHEST - Bench vs Ring Push Ups, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/K4UBm1dV6WM?t=375)). 2023-24: weighted dips are S tier, "squat of the upper body", and he dropped bench after shoulder injuries ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=255); [So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=821); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=1205)).
- **Lat pulldowns.** 2020-21: replace them with pull-ups; he used no pulldowns ([5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/eobG2o3Ww4M?t=500); [Weak point Wednesday： Lats (how I will grow mine), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/J9Y9VZhnZ5M?t=383)). 2022-24: close-grip neutral and iliac pulldowns are top tier, and the pulldown is the best pull-up substitute, worth rotating in anyway ([The ULTIMATE Back/Lats Exercises Tier-List (Yujiro-tier to Peewee-tier), 2022-11](https://youtu.be/Cbq-vxVba4k?t=567); [1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=1729)).
- **Incline curls.** 2020-22: poor, mediocre, C tier ([Icecream Fitness Program review, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/5Wz0xTfWOOs?t=502); [The ULTIMATE Biceps Exercises Tier-List (Arnold-tier to Noodle-tier), 2022-10](https://youtu.be/RwEJpHTwWm0?t=376)). 2023-24: A/S tier, and he admits he was "just bad at it" ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=1079); [Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6yW3GSskl8g?t=64)).
- **Squat style.** 2020: deep (back) squats are the best leg builder; never Smith squat ([The dangers of dirty bulking (and why I don't recommend it), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/a02c10s3Pjk?t=130); [AlphaDestiny Novice Program review (part. 2： FAQ), 2020-04](https://youtu.be/T_DyRlu3Y7I?t=505)). 2023-24: 80% of his squat volume is heel-elevated, he back squats ~once a month, all squats heel-elevated, and Smith feet-forward squats and Smith split squats are top tier ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=759); [The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1695); [How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=126); [The ULTIMATE Quads/Legs Exercises Tier-List (Platz-tier to Chicken-tier), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/_IBSNO56zuE?t=500)).
- **Unilateral/split squats/lunges.** 2020: bias against unilateral work; never lunges (knees) ([Push/Pull Pull/Legs Legs/Push 3 days program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/eFhwWirR70o?t=190); [Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 1)： Causes & symptoms, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/awroGsPwNPU?t=382)). 2023-24: unilateral A tier, split squats his favourite leg lift, reverse lunges S tier ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=2520); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=300); [The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/9L90ktKGPLw?t=942)).
- **Machines/cables.** 2020: machines for advanced lifters only, he is biased against them, no machines in his program ([Fierce 5 novice program review (from an hypertrophy standpoint), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/OATtf3kPtdI?t=187); [5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/eobG2o3Ww4M?t=437); [Free 3 times a week full body hypertrophy program, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/xFVva4-swKc)). 2023-24: machine shoulder press S tier, cable laterals best, he moved most triceps work to cables/Smith, and machines let you train hard ([The ULTIMATE Shoulder Exercises Tier-List (Boulder-tier to Pebble-tier), 2023-02](https://youtu.be/k3yRgcmiCls?t=1447); [So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=5092); [I am officially obese (Hypertrophy Log #7), 2024-08](https://youtu.be/sZntx8mqaH8?t=377)).
- **Leg extensions and leg curls.** 2020-21: leg extensions are subpar and knee-risky; prefer hinges over curls ([Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/GClcGq2tIDU?t=1450); [Jeff Nippard's Push Pull Legs program review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/pey1Ni6HPlY?t=810)). 2023: leg extensions Platz tier, lying leg curl S tier ([The ULTIMATE Quads/Legs Exercises Tier-List (Platz-tier to Chicken-tier), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/_IBSNO56zuE?t=2954); [The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/9L90ktKGPLw?t=2013)).
- **Specificity.** 2020-21: must be respected; the tree of specificity governs selection ([The hypertrophy series： using lifting rotations to maximize quality tonnage, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/uRWgz3nhqds); [Minimalist training bad, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/w4-2c3iWvDQ?t=1255)). 2023-24: C tier, "not important for bodybuilding" ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=3212); [The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=2072)).
- **Overhead press.** 2020: a big fan of barbell OHP ([3 days Upper 2 days Lower program review (for an advanced calisthenics guy part., 2020-11](https://youtu.be/D3mJh0ZA5nc?t=648)). 2024: "plateau machine"; he dropped it for a Smith 80° incline press ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=2219); [So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=5510)).
- **Push-ups.** 2020: too easy for advanced lifters ([The hypertrophy series： strength baseline control for recovery & gains, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Vbk_2AALm3M?t=318)). 2022-24: not only for novices; he regrets dropping them ([My TOP 3 Calisthenics Chest Exercises (Exotic Push-Ups For Muscle Growth), 2022-01](https://youtu.be/vyKzL85QwY4?t=65); [The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1508)).
- **JM press.** 2020: disliked as an elbow-unfriendly hybrid ([5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 1), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/TD9SB9Bt45o?t=1351)). 2022-24: excellent and elbow-saving ([The ULTIMATE Triceps Exercises Tier-List (Mythical-tier to Toothpick-tier), 2022-10](https://youtu.be/ylmTf9Qb6jg?t=879); [Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=567)).
- **Hip thrusts.** 2022-23: fine add-on, S tier ([Get your GF in the Gym (Girl Fitness Program), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/CVHNXyR5yCY?t=687); [The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/9L90ktKGPLw?t=2390)). 2024: dislikes them as redundant ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=7318); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=5210)).
- **Pendlay rows.** 2020: good for strength and size ([Response to Husaka - CHEST - Bench vs Ring Push Ups, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/K4UBm1dV6WM?t=1762)). 2022-24: mediocre for lats, not a good hypertrophy movement ([The ULTIMATE Back/Lats Exercises Tier-List (Yujiro-tier to Peewee-tier), 2022-11](https://youtu.be/Cbq-vxVba4k?t=1567); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=4560)).
- **Calisthenics/rings.** 2020: rings have a poor technicality-to-hypertrophy ratio ([Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/9M7QVlvFdQY?t=1444)). 2024: calisthenics for the upper body plus free weights for legs is the ideal, and how he trains ([This Calisthenics Freak Makes Bodybuilders Look Small (Baki_HD), 2024-06](https://youtu.be/2LoP6-KdEx4?t=1130)).
- **Pull-up volume.** 2020: "you can never do too many pull-ups" ([FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/b4rMVrWFVEg?t=754)). 2023: his old novice program had too many; now fewer, weighted ([ULTIMATE HYPERTROPHY PROGRAMS (Novice to Advanced), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/gpFdh0eBMGc?t=500)).
- **Leg extensions are also contradicted inside 2020** (no extensions needed vs accept if you like them). This is treated as tolerance, not a change ([FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/b4rMVrWFVEg?t=754); [3 days PPL program review, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/hi-kNbZnXz0?t=688)).

**Contradictions**

- **Rotation scheduling.** 2020: rotations "should always be scheduled, not done by feel" ([Rotating lifts： What it should & shouldn't be, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/z9MDwMO8K4Y)). 2022: rotations should never be scheduled (e.g. every two weeks) or triggered by a plateau, only "when the muscle needs it" ([Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02](https://youtu.be/BJXFeQWGUuY?t=2078)). 2023: scheduled for most people, autoregulated for advanced lifters ([How to Keep Growing FOREVER (Unlimited Hypertrophy Method), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/1TKqwXCge9E?t=1389)), which may reconcile the two.
- **Barbell rows in his programs.** 2021: "none of his programs, novice or otherwise, include barbell rows" ([Why Novices shouldn't do Barbell Rows, 2021-08](https://youtu.be/Q5y4wM8zcWY?t=189)). Yet many templates include them: swimming template rows 3x8-10 ([Lifting plans for Athletes (programming for sports), 2021-09](https://youtu.be/cNGPCn9Uupc)), barbell/seal rows 4x8-12 ([The PERFECT Hybrid Calisthenics Program (Feat Bald Omni Man), 2023-01](https://youtu.be/_P0-kYyVMn4?t=505)), 2023 barbell rows as the day's hinge ([Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/7uBT8vp0lNw?t=509)).
- **Leg curls/isolation for his own legs.** 2023-24 he rates the lying leg curl S tier and the leg extension Platz tier ([The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/9L90ktKGPLw?t=2013); [The ULTIMATE Quads/Legs Exercises Tier-List (Platz-tier to Chicken-tier), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/_IBSNO56zuE?t=2954)). But in 2024 he trains legs only with free weights and hip hinges "despite evidence" ([New hypertrophy study just dropped (And Basically You're F＊cking Stupid), 2024-01](https://youtu.be/vVQmYGw7Kj8?t=1954)). Same year, his staples include belt squats and Smith work ([The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1695); [20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/qvWxIzhT1QU?t=759)).
- **Importance of exercise selection.** 2021: "exercise selection dictates how your physique turns out, so it is paramount" ([The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07](https://youtu.be/8ELQ2XZgpls?t=1891)). Also 2021: for naturals "exercise selection is a by-product" of programming ([3 steps to follow for Bigger Arms, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/K1GVimJowoM)). 2023: only B tier ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=3212)).
- **Band curls.** "Mediocre, use for recovery" ([The ULTIMATE Biceps Exercises Tier-List (Arnold-tier to Noodle-tier), 2022-10](https://youtu.be/RwEJpHTwWm0?t=1699)) vs "excellent, the only curl he really feels" ([Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=4878)).
- **Pullovers for chest.** "Best complement to the bench" and a chest/lat builder ([Top 3 most underrated exercises, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/AFK9x4EZh2Q?t=127); [Farnese Hercules Bodybuilding Program (Ancient Greek Herculean Physique Workout), 2022-03](https://youtu.be/IYobXlRVLd0?t=746)) vs "mediocre for chest" and "not a chest lift" ([The ULTIMATE Chest Exercises Tier-List (Gorilla-tier to A cup-tier), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/cUkWvnY8AJI?t=3324); [Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6yW3GSskl8g?t=507)).
- **Leg press.** 2021: dislikes it, causes lower back pain ([Viking's the Bare Bones Series Program review, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/8mGHG5C-EPE?t=497)) vs 2022/2024: a fine leg builder and the pick for people with lower back problems ([Greek Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program (Apollonian Physique Workout), 2022-05](https://youtu.be/SPicD3F686s?t=1123); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=2094)).
- **Seal vs Pendlay rows.** Seal rows are among the best rows ([5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08](https://youtu.be/4ORCb_i7MxY?t=185)) vs he prefers Pendlay and hates a chest pad ([Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06](https://youtu.be/QfHfxLYRu88?t=2515)).
- **Kroc rows.** Slightly inferior to DB rows, explosive without negative control ([The ULTIMATE Back/Lats Exercises Tier-List (Yujiro-tier to Peewee-tier), 2022-11](https://youtu.be/Cbq-vxVba4k?t=882)) vs "incredibly underrated, unmatched for traps" ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=2584)). These may just be different muscles judged (lats vs traps).

## Fatigue deload

**Changed over time**

- **Wording on "never deload" refined.** In 2020 he said he never deloads ( ([The training principles series： deloads, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/CRXE2gFfwcs?t=188))). By 2022 he clarified that he deloads constantly through set/rep management, just not the powerlifter way ( ([Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03](https://youtu.be/PuIp9cGKMHo?t=3712))). Later view: deloading is built in.
- **Form of an acceptable deload.** In 2020 the "objectively better deload" was usual lifts at low intensity and volume ( ([The training principles series： deloads, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/CRXE2gFfwcs?t=64))). In 2024 he said even an active deload far from failure is wasted for hypertrophy ( ([Why everyone HATES Paul Carter (liftrunbang1), 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ZRNSc-xBVnc?t=691))), yet in a separate 2024 video he called 2 sets at 2 RIR reasonable ( ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=6800))). Later stance: harder against it, with that one exception.
- **SFR downgraded.** In 2022 he treated it as a simple valid concept ( ([Biomechanics Gurus™ need to 𝚂𝙷𝚄𝚃 𝚄𝙿 about Optimal Training, 2022-10](https://youtu.be/nmgidpn3DNM?t=571))). He ranked it B tier in 2023 ( ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=943))) and 5th, "an excuse", in 2024 ( ([Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6yW3GSskl8g?t=1203))).
- **His own lower-body recovery.** In 2022 he trained legs every two days ( ([Superhero Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program (Kinobody Hollywood Physique Workout), 2022-08](https://youtu.be/o_x3Ij2GBXM?t=440))). In 2025 he said he needs ~72 h because recovery lags as strength rises ( ([New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03](https://youtu.be/ACFKXT44BzM?t=688))). Later view: 72 h.

**Contradictions**

- **Is feel a valid gauge?** In 2020 he said how you feel during and the day after a workout means nothing for judging volume ( ([Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/MIHPylz3f7Q?t=378))). The same year he said to judge extra tonnage by sensations and soreness 4 days later ( ([The hypertrophy series： maintaining tonnage stability for long term progress, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Z1xF6eFUdBQ?t=254))) and to "let your body be the judge" for CNS ( ([Hypertrophy Q&A #4, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/ZScs2L9rero?t=2100))).
- **Is overtraining real?** In 2020 he called it real ( ([The training principles series： overtraining, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/PLgCL_rizPU))) and also "a myth" ( ([Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/6sFaB3rAY1A?t=3206))). He also said most people needn't worry about muscular fatigue ( ([The hypertrophy series： stimulus to fatigue ratio, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/boPKiKE26Rw?t=127))) but that most who think they overtrain are right ( ([Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/9M7QVlvFdQY?t=125))).
- **Day-to-day interference.** In 2022 he said deadlift Monday then barbell rows Tuesday won't work ( ([Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06](https://youtu.be/QfHfxLYRu88?t=690))). In 2024 he said lats to failure then RDLs the next day doesn't hurt him, and doubted that one day's training hurts the next (garbled; ([BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=7431))).

## Fitness industry

**Changed over time**

- **Monetisation and coaching.** Earlier: he would never monetise, never write programs on request or sell programs (2020). Coaching is a scam ~99% of the time (2020). "If he ever sells a paid program, unsubscribe" (2021) ([FREE 4/5 days Gentleman split (part. 1), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/cGzlMRCxvxo); [RANT： You don't need a coach, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/UKr-dWXa73Q?t=125); [Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/JpSZFxsTyKk?t=2007)). Still in Sept 2024 he refused to coach ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=9520)). Later: Ko-fi donations (2023), then Ko-fi memberships plus a coaching/teaching service from Dec 2024, and the "strategist" tier in 2025 with custom programs. He frames it as teaching independence and accepts some criticism as warranted ([Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/hXx-KDH2p28?t=10735); [RIP Natural Hypertrophy; Welcome School of Strategy!, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/J9_udWdk6ZM?t=400); [Community post (1 year ago, approx date), 2025-10](https://www.youtube.com/post/Ugkxn0YHyZLc9USUjmqcjFXA-dyafYALjX3c); [Ko-fi page (captured 2026-10-20), 2026-10](https://ko-fi.com/naturalhypertrophy)). The later view is the current one. YouTube itself stays unmonetised.
- **Main PED problem.** 2020-2022: fake naturals are the enemy ([My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/RlnOXG0OjPE?t=1150)). 2022-2025: PED "honesty" made use mainstream, and by 2025 honest enhanced influencers are the main problem ([Mike Israetel's DANGEROUS steroid advice, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/98cRcFkEN8o?t=378); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=1512)).
- **Natty-or-not videos.** 2020: he won't make them, but they help newcomers learn natural limits ([Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Cn38kgCdOhw)). 2021-2024: they help nobody and "produce nothing good" ([Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/JpSZFxsTyKk?t=2197); [10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/loDNjTHZjG4?t=2461)).
- **Science-based channels.** 2021: he predicts they'll lose traction ([The Galaxy Brains of YT Fitness have ruined science, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/662MjNpnQcw?t=1005)). 2022: Nippard is the best programming channel and the current era may be YouTube fitness's best for creator quality ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠ： Jeff Nippard, Eric Bugenhagen, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/GowuEmDClqY?t=1755); [My channel was deleted, but...I AM BACK! (A Great Victory Against Censorship...T, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/NV6tkzYeKgE?t=1453)). 2024: he wants a middle ground and calls Nippard decent, while criticising the science-based community's dogmatism ([Jeff Nippard assaulted by steroid loser Mike Van Wyck, 2024-10](https://youtu.be/cjviSWDFw0c?t=881); [The Hypocrisy of Science-Based Lifters, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/RPc1lnNNXNg?t=819)). This is a refinement rather than a reversal.

**Contradictions**

- **Naming people.** He says criticise practices, not people, asks permission before naming anyone, and won't do natty-or-not on individuals ([Fake Merc Character Study (part. 5)： Moody Dick, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/OtoSjIZudIA?t=826); [Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/KMcJAERb9Dk?t=125); [Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Cn38kgCdOhw)). Yet he ran long named series on Blaha and Nether and publicly graded dozens of named creators ([Fake Merc Character Study (part. 20)： To coath a Predator, 2022-05](https://youtu.be/y1G3r3UOar0?t=2642); [Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/umQZm2ALxl8?t=1049)). His stated exception is people he considers dangerous ([Censorship on Youtube： How Greg Doucette betrayed the entire Fitness community b, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/vVlpg3202Uw?t=120)).
- **Insult styles.** The "daddy-talk" insulting style is exploitative ([The Brainlets of YT Fitness don't understand Science, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/EP1Qw9aEKOU?t=2112); [Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/umQZm2ALxl8?t=3297)), versus "insulting obese people into action can work" ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/umQZm2ALxl8?t=1359)). He also deliberately offends viewers to break parasocial bonds ([Fanboyism is a mental illness： How Youtubers steal your identity through parasoc, 2021-04](https://youtu.be/j1bS37-7AHA?t=963)).
- **Buying programs.** "Paying for a program is a waste" and "stop buying programs" ([Free novice program for hypertrophy, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/_4wWgin1dVY?t=504); [The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=2512)), versus recommending specific paid programs as worth it ([Jeff Nippard & Minimalism： Working Hard or Hardly Working?, 2022-10](https://youtu.be/Zv9QAIb5nGk?t=2711); [Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (VI： Liver King, Alex Eubank, Jujimufu, 2022-12](https://youtu.be/uF-j7u5VLaY?t=63)).
- **Physique as credential.** "Being bigger is not an argument" (science_evidence) and "experience isn't how a physique looks" ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/umQZm2ALxl8?t=187)), versus "don't take hypertrophy advice from small people" ([Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/fPU3nRIH8sM?t=6408)). He reconciles these via the halo-effect caveat and his natural-only rule.

## Frequency split

**Changed over time**

- **His own split.** 2020-2023: 6 days/week on an 8-day rotation of themed day pairs, Sunday off, so a full cycle takes 9 days ([My sets/frequency for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/m_IGaiqrCvA); [FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/o3RTXWAia4A?t=65); [My Program to go BERSERKER MODE (BODYBUILDING GOAL PHYSIQUE), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/itnjfi6RYtY?t=188); [Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=187)). 2024-03: upper/lower 6x/week ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=379)). 2024-09: went from 7 to 6 to 5 days: 3 upper (2 torso, 1 arms) + 2 lower ([Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/JW73oft8Q60?t=1090); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=5023)). 2024-12: upper 3x, lower 2x ([20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/qvWxIzhT1QU?t=759)). 2025-01: 3 home + 2 commercial gym sessions + 2 backyard carry sessions ([You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/0O0nG2jLadU?t=824)). Later view: fewer, harder days.
- **Frequency vs intensity.** 2021-2022: frequency and duration beat intensity, and trading frequency for intensity is "questionable" ([ANIME WORKOUTS - Can you train like a Baki character? A Grappler Baki Training G, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/6K7xyjI5lYE?t=374); [Mike Mentzer： Mustachioed fraud or Bodybuilding genius? (🆃🅷🅴 🅷🅸, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/lmhW2W2UQto?t=1201); [How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/z2uzpl_smSg?t=2275)). 2023: stronger lifters need longer recovery windows, and he trains high-frequency because he cannot produce the per-session intensity Alex can ([The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05](https://youtu.be/mMA3KF3qmlQ?t=1696)). 2024: "never sacrifice intensity for frequency", while sacrificing frequency for intensity is fine. Training less often lets him train harder with unchanged gains ([How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=945); [Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/JW73oft8Q60?t=1140)). Later view: intensity is protected first.
- **Leg frequency.** 2020-2024-05: legs every 48 h / 3x/week, and once a week is terrible ([How I utilize body part splits for maximum muscle hypertrophy (versus upper lowe, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/4FY2Ct22qXU?t=503); [This is Peak Bulk (Hypertrophy Log #6), 2024-05](https://youtu.be/l6L6HlGM4F0?t=189)). 2023-2024: Alex's legs grow on 1x/week, and legs 1x/week is fine while fixing an upper weakness ([The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05](https://youtu.be/mMA3KF3qmlQ?t=943); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=4630)). 2024-12: he trains legs 2x/week with 72-96 h between sessions, because 3x/week becomes unrecoverable at ~400s squat / ~500s RDL ([How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=1009); [How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12](https://youtu.be/-OjJEzZTXtQ?t=945)). Later view: 2x/week for strong advanced lifters.
- **Full body.** 2020: "not a big fan", it rarely digs deep per muscle and most people slap compounds together ([FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/b4rMVrWFVEg?t=1130); [How to program a Gentleman split, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/a4TKJvbCAf0?t=624); [The issue with HIT (the intensity meme), 2020-11](https://youtu.be/LqsqSGZooR0?t=1064)), though 3x/week has a good fatigue ratio ([ANIME WORKOUTS - Can you look like Baki Hanma in real life?, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/dfnn-YdXerg?t=825)). 2023-2024: "full-body splits are good splits", 3x/week is "one of the best templates" and 2x/week is excellent for busy lifters ([Bodybuilder Roasts AI Generated Program 👨‍💻, 2023-01](https://youtu.be/BiVfpZEchws?t=627); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=10617); [Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=5738)). Later view: positive.
- **PPL.** 2020: standard PPL is the worst order and lower-biased, and its core flaw is why he promoted body-part splits ([Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/GClcGq2tIDU?t=1196); [Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/GClcGq2tIDU?t=1769)). 2023-2024: PPL's bad reputation is unwarranted and it is a very good split (still in pull-push-legs order) ([The ULTIMATE PPL Program (Doom Slayer Physique), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/DA7QvIAyptw); [So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=3245)). Later view: positive.
- **"Body-part split" label.** 2020: a well-built body-part split is the smartest and best natural template ([How I split up my week for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/cHYOYTgiRlM?t=63); [Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/A4KNy_uMCRM?t=7)). 2021-2023: body-part splits are "the worst template for gaining muscle" and push you into junk volume to justify the session ([Analyzing the Rock's ＂Black Adam＂ training program, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/BnzVYV9_IQc?t=64); [Analyzing Chris Bumstead's training program, 2021-08](https://youtu.be/qq459xqmq5A?t=440); [The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/Mn34v5Y1d-0?t=1885)). The underlying idea (synergistic multi-muscle days at 2x/week) stayed the same under the name "gentleman split". The change is mostly terminology.
- **Back days.** 2020: the back is the one muscle where a bro-split day makes sense (huge tonnage from many angles) ([6 days french bodybuilding split review, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/eaXDVkHjsZQ?t=814)). 2022-2024: never have a back day, cap 3 exercises per day and spread back volume ([Level up your back, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/dVssxcEh1UQ?t=764); [Does Mr. Olympia know how to train BACK? (Analyzing Chris Bumstead's Workout w/ , 2022-10](https://youtu.be/bJ7gfILR6RA?t=1505); [Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Sam Sulek, Max Euceda, Lex Little), 2024-01](https://youtu.be/jDk3LytTEjA?t=2523)). Later view: no back day.
- **Triceps extensions supersetted with presses.** 2020 recommended: long-head triceps work between press back-off sets does not hurt pressing ([FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/o3RTXWAia4A?t=379); [FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/o3RTXWAia4A?t=315)). 2024: he no longer believes in it, and the pairing appears only in his old programs ([BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=7431)).
- **Deadlift frequency for himself.** 2020-01: floor pulls every 4 days ([My sets/frequency for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/m_IGaiqrCvA?t=191)). 2020-03: heavy conventional every 8 days ([Who can afford to only squat and deadlift once a week?, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/awNEfmfGkmY?t=63)). 2020-12: heavy deadlift 2x/week ([Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/QLUXXk0OtX4?t=624)). 2022: heavy hinge every 2 days, and a bodybuilder needs it only every 2-3 days ([𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/yoROLGGUPXU?t=1555); [3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/qrBLykvU_EE?t=941)). 2023-2024: advises cutting deadlifts to 1x/week (at most 2) ([This is why you don't have a Demon Back (Advanced Tips), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/4t72r8Q0vXQ?t=630); [Why everyone HATES Paul Carter (liftrunbang1), 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ZRNSc-xBVnc?t=254)). Later advice: the deadlift proper ~1x/week, with hinge variations more often.

**Contradictions**

- **Deadlift frequency (same period).** In 2020-12 he says deadlift "only a few times a month, never every two days" ([How to do deadlifts for SIZE, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/3IMgRqcRN4Y?t=2005)) and also reports heavy deadlifts twice a week ([Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/QLUXXk0OtX4?t=624)). In 2022 he hinges heavy every 2 days ([How to do squats for SIZE, 2022-09](https://youtu.be/XAcv427WvMw?t=1140)). Partly reconciled by deadlift vs hinge variations, but not fully.
- **Back & biceps pairing.** 2020: back day always involves biceps and forearms, so back and biceps "fits naturally" ([6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/2ag0uM9zhs4?t=217)). Same year and later: low synergy, and an arm day is better ([Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/GClcGq2tIDU?t=690); [Level up your back, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/dVssxcEh1UQ?t=1770); [Bodybuilder Roasts AI Generated Program 👨‍💻, 2023-01](https://youtu.be/BiVfpZEchws?t=315)). He also pairs lats with biceps after weighted chins (2023) ([This is why you don't have a Demon Back (Advanced Tips), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/4t72r8Q0vXQ?t=1255)).
- **Chest and upper back on the same day.** 2020: do not put chest and upper back on the same upper day ([Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/9M7QVlvFdQY?t=504)). Elsewhere: superset chest with upper back on upper days, and chest and back are fine antagonists to pair ([Candito Upper Lower Hypertrophy Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/4aThavRpYLw?t=1570); [How the King of Zoomers Trains to Look like a Greek God (Alex Eubank Program Rev, 2022-12](https://youtu.be/0pKnDucWcDc?t=376); [5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08](https://youtu.be/4ORCb_i7MxY?t=248)).
- **Training back every day.** 2022/2024: back can be trained every session or every day if parts are rotated ([Does Mr. Olympia know how to train BACK? (Analyzing Chris Bumstead's Workout w/ , 2022-10](https://youtu.be/bJ7gfILR6RA?t=1567); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=3290)). 2023: "never train back every day", and one back exercise six days a week is a bad idea ([Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/7uBT8vp0lNw?t=1701); [Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/7uBT8vp0lNw?t=1386)).
- **Same muscle on consecutive days.** 2020-04: he never trains the same muscle two days in a row (48 h protein synthesis) ([The hypertrophy series： maximum recoverable volume, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/tZ9CSu2DMIE?t=186)), and 2024 calls 48 h a bare minimum ([So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=257)). But 2020 and 2022: two days in a row is valid, and so is 90/80/70% Mon-Wed ([5 Ways to shock the muscle (GONE WRONG), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/RqS8AxVE28I?t=62); [Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02](https://youtu.be/BJXFeQWGUuY?t=1141)). A plausible reconciliation is hard vs light hits, but he does not always state it.
- **Heavy/light day structures.** He rejects heavy/light and volume/intensity days ([7 days split program review (Rubgy focus), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/u10c43TRDb0?t=1196); [Upper Lower Light/Heavy 4 days split with mirror Week program review (part. 2), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/DukfPhcoYZE?t=490); [The hypertrophy series： modulating session timeframe to control volume/intensity, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/QAgxfDd4kWY?t=313)), yet he describes gentleman days as heavy/moderate/pump ([Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/A4KNy_uMCRM?t=682)), recommends heavy/medium/light full body for intermediates ([Fullbody template review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/G7rVTseabFU?t=830)), and suggests alternating strength weeks with giant-set weeks ([5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/eobG2o3Ww4M?t=626)).
- **Full body days per week.** 2021: 4 days is the sweet spot, and 2x cannot accumulate enough volume ([Fullbody template review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/G7rVTseabFU?t=1050); [Fullbody template review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/G7rVTseabFU?t=1650)). 2023: 2 not enough, 3 perfect, 4 too much ([The Best Natural Lifter You've NEVER Heard Of (Hersovyac), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/-sf34ScWLK8?t=316)). 2024: 2x/week is excellent for busy lifters ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=5738)).
- **Where legs go in a full-body session.** 2021: train legs last so presses have energy ([The Silver Era Hercules： Steve Reeves (Legends of the Past), 2021-12](https://youtu.be/qcRCMVABEQM?t=863)). 2023: start with legs, they are most taxing ([The Natty FREAK with Superhero Aesthetics (Bald Omni-Man), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/Z-hGdKz28RY?t=313)).
- **Upper work on lower days.** 2020: he dislikes hammer curls, pushdowns and triceps extensions on lower days, because they turn the day into a body-part split ([4 days Upper Lower program review, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/ZKgM-tX_ODU?t=484)). Elsewhere: add upper-back, arm and isolation work to lower days, and "rigid splits are mostly idiotic" ([How to structure a Gentleman split (volume & intensity), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/ehxjCB_MdKc?t=147); [My Program to go BERSERKER MODE (BODYBUILDING GOAL PHYSIQUE), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/itnjfi6RYtY?t=564); [1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=10099)).
- **Upper/lower verdict, 2020.** "Upper/lower is the best skeleton" ([How to program a Gentleman split, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/a4TKJvbCAf0?t=249)) vs he dislikes upper/lower because lower days cram squats and deadlifts together ([FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03](https://youtu.be/b4rMVrWFVEg?t=690)).
- **Arm day order.** 2021: curls and extensions first when freshest ([3 steps to follow for Bigger Arms, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/K1GVimJowoM?t=430)). 2020/2023: open with a heavy compound ([Want big arms? Get an arm day, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/iX9lLFDvw_w?t=254); [We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/d1eLAd5WvIA?t=2691)).
- **Arm day next to upper days.** 2020: arm day "won't take away" from strength and can sit between heavy days or on rest days ([How to program an arm day (the Natural Hypertrophy example), 2020-01](https://youtu.be/gVVj9QuCyFM?t=63)). A 2020 template puts a horizontal press on arm day ([FREE 4/5 days Gentleman split (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/1f4aaqgOfXk?t=289)), while 2021/2023 say never put arm days next to or between upper days ([Good arm day Vs Bad arm day, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/RSkzA1l5jlk?t=693); [The Monster Natty that trains EVERY DAY (Geoffrey Verity Schofield), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/aJ1e41y8Na4?t=945)). The second pair is about adjacency to upper days, so this is partly compatible.

## Genetics potential

**Changed over time**

- **How much he credits genetics**: 2020 says genetics "won't be treated as an important factor" on his channel and are irrelevant to reaching potential ([What having bad genetics means (to me), 2020-04](https://youtu.be/CrPz7efvTGU?t=372); [What having bad genetics means (to me), 2020-04](https://youtu.be/CrPz7efvTGU?t=309)). In 2024-25 he openly ranks lifters on a 1-10 scale, tells roommate stories as "proof genetics exist", and says "a 5 can only achieve what a 5 can" ([Why you shouldn't listen to Genetic Freaks (The Joel Williams Example), 2024-02](https://youtu.be/GyK1Y6WTR-g?t=2213); [Story Time (Top 10 NH stories), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/TvKzeUKgZcY?t=3536); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=1885)). Later view: genetics set the ceiling and speed, but still are no excuse.
- **Natural limit**: 2020-23 says there is no limit, you "progress until you die", and limits exist only if you believe them ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 5), 2020-08](https://youtu.be/O-x2v688wrg?t=503); [RANT： Discipline & work ethic are NOT genetic traits!, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/-i6A0etUfmE?t=631); [The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05](https://youtu.be/mMA3KF3qmlQ?t=2265)). 2024: limits exist but you can't locate them, so be "delusional" and keep training ([Your standards are too low., 2024-12](https://youtu.be/uKOuj3Mzc9c?t=1134)). Later view = refined.
- **Self-rating**: 2020 "bad" or "bottom-of-the-barrel" genetics, with 8 in 10 people better ([10 Year Natural Transformation 15-25 (from 110 to 210 lbs), 2020-04](https://youtu.be/yenqGI_FVQ4?t=448); [The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 14), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/mO3cqgBEqdc?t=1327)); 2024 "5/10, roughly average" ([Your standards are too low., 2024-12](https://youtu.be/uKOuj3Mzc9c?t=1197)). Later view = average.
- **Minimum time before judging genetics**: 1 year (2021-22) ([Swole shaming is real, BIGot, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/eKBDacpRYSU?t=2203); [You are the flea in the mayonnaise jar (GENETICS RANT), 2022-04](https://youtu.be/EdfnJor78OQ?t=1584)) → 10 years (2023) ([5 Secrets of Elite Natural Lifters, 2023-10](https://youtu.be/iU-oYc8fbEM?t=1454)).

**Contradictions**

- **Is natural potential unlimited?** "Effectively unlimited" and "almost infinite" ([Lifting natty is a waste of time, 2022-09](https://youtu.be/ihFhv7P3wpI?t=460); [Why you will NEVER have freaky, thick forearms if your wrists are small (Natty o, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/YHm-qSHgGSk)) vs "not infinite or equal to enhanced; 270 lb at 5% impossible" ([My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/RlnOXG0OjPE?t=1437)) (both 2021-22).
- **Can everyone achieve it?** "No person on Earth lacks the ability to build a good physique" ([You are the flea in the mayonnaise jar (GENETICS RANT), 2022-04](https://youtu.be/EdfnJor78OQ?t=2838)) vs "telling everyone they can achieve anything is an insult to people who lack what it takes" ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠⅠ： AthleanX, Kinobody, Scott , 2022-05](https://youtu.be/wNunDhhIvRE?t=2193)) (both 2022).
- **Hard gainers**: "hard gainers do not exist" ([Natty or not (.com)： Alpha Destiny, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/DrAKKhJU0fY?t=2228)) vs truly cursed lifters "exist but are rare" and a true hardgainer has a hormonal handicap ([Tales of Genetics： Lifting Anomalies, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/YMURbaXNNZM); [5 diet tips for hardgainers, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/6nKKGsCCqxo)). This is mostly a difference of degree.
- **Tall lifters' speed**: "may progress faster thanks to absolute strength" ([Advice to look thick for tall/wide lifters (best practices & mindset), 2020-09](https://youtu.be/qlIicZePKtU?t=253)) vs "need more time to build muscle naturally" ([Generation Aesthetics： Zyzz, the Godfather of Terrible Role Models, 2021-12](https://youtu.be/k80R-bpvcRk?t=1107)). Reconciled in 2024 as strength gains at the same speed, visual change slower ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=9983)).

## Injuries

**Changed over time**

- **Pain handling: absolutist → graded.** 2020: "never lift through pain; if a movement hurts, stop" ([How to work around pain, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/1R42snjAX4I); [Tips to combat shoulder pain, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/IahVc0kbGOU?t=501)). 2021: graded occurrence/aftermath scales, with minor pain to be pushed aside, nocebo awareness, and level-2 pain where you may push through ([Did I just snap my sh＊t up? (an injury assessment guide & pain psychology discus, 2021-09](https://youtu.be/Z90VsPDV__U?t=1528); [Did I just snap my sh＊t up? (an injury assessment guide & pain psychology discus, 2021-09](https://youtu.be/Z90VsPDV__U?t=2113)). Later (2022-2025) he still treats tendon/joint pain as a stop signal ([3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/qrBLykvU_EE); [10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01](https://youtu.be/waeSP7DBmig?t=370)). The later view is graded, but the stop rule still holds for tendons.
- **Front delts and shoulder health.** 2020: front-delt isolation instead of pressing fixed his shoulders, and a strong front delt prevents injury ([Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/KMcJAERb9Dk?t=1123); [Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/KMcJAERb9Dk?t=1630); [Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/KMcJAERb9Dk?t=1817)). 2022: overdeveloped front delts versus weak rear/side delts invite injury; he shrank his front delts, built rear delts/traps, and the injuries stopped ([𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/yoROLGGUPXU?t=710)). The 2022 view is later; both agree that rear delts matter.
- **Dips and shoulders.** 2020: dips are usually worse than bench for bad shoulders, ring dips "double the risk" ([Program critique #1 (Upper Lower Push Pull), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/np9LdwTPfNs?t=762); [Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/MIHPylz3f7Q?t=1553)). 2023-2024: avoiding dips while doubling down on bench is where shoulder injuries happen, and dips help shoulders ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=191); [Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=2036)). The later view is pro-dip.
- **Close-grip bench.** 2020: a shoulder-friendly swap (3×6-10) that "repeats well" ([Boring but Big program review, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/hT4zgNcMOBY?t=501); [5 days Upper Lower (2 Uppers 2 Lowers + 1 Arm day) program review, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/dHXPhjaWBWk?t=1572)). 2023: he dropped it after it gave him elbow tendinitis and posterior shoulder pain ([Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=1634); [Wild Man Training (Hypertrophy Log #0), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/P7ADeDVghxg?t=1120)).
- **Bench press itself.** 2020-2022: kept benching via Slingshot/paused/Spoto ([Should you buy this instead of a slingshot? (Bench daddy review), 2020-01](https://youtu.be/Pr6to3cPR1g); [The ULTIMATE Chest Exercises Tier-List (Gorilla-tier to A cup-tier), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/cUkWvnY8AJI?t=1565)). 2024: he dropped (flat-back, full-range) bench because it destroyed his shoulders ([Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=4943)).
- **Warm-up volume.** 2020: long warm-ups (empty bar + 25-30 reps; knees 35-40 min) ([The training principles series： warming up & stretching, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/PxMpAWWtcrg?t=319); [How I program my Squat days for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/j5PP3gx7DC4?t=314)). 2025: 1-2 sets are enough for tendons ([10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01](https://youtu.be/waeSP7DBmig?t=66)). This is a refinement and may reflect different contexts.
- **Pullover reps.** 2020-2021: ≥6 ([Injury Q&A #1, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/VXwYO2qG9ZY?t=255); [Injury Q&A #4, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/9kIIW251uiI?t=692)). 2022: 8-12 ([Silver Era Aesthetics Program (Steve Reeves Physique Workout), 2022-10](https://youtu.be/g-pqgciOSgE?t=1135)). A refinement upward.
- **Causes of tendinitis.** 2020-2021: movement and lifestyle stress, with stress possibly the main factor ([Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 1)： Causes & symptoms, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/awroGsPwNPU?t=382); [When Snap City occurs, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/Z35bJjrc_MY?t=191)). Late 2021: diet inflammation only minor, movement matters far more ([TENDINITIS, BEGONE! (Healing Tendinopathy / Tendon Pain Rehab for Lifters), 2021-11](https://youtu.be/KzXUgd-SnMw?t=181)).

**Contradictions**

- **What fixed his knees: big quads or posterior chain?** 2020-2021: growing his quads (~23 in), "not glutes or hamstrings", cured his patellar tendinitis, and the quads protect the tendon ([Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/KMcJAERb9Dk?t=1059); [Injury Q&A #4, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/9kIIW251uiI?t=190); [Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 2)： Rehab & precautions, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/vHf2ZoHWHQs?t=1258)). 2020: big quads relative to posterior chain cause his knee problems ([How I program my Squat days for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/j5PP3gx7DC4)). 2022: relearning the squat and building big hamstrings and glutes fixed his knee pain ([𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/yoROLGGUPXU?t=1150)).
- **Biceps low reps.** 2020-09: very experienced lifters can carefully do 3-5 ([How to start using evolving rep ranges in your training, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/HpEz3fFWEeA?t=400)). 2020-11: no 2-5 rep ranges for biceps ([Synchronizing evolving rep range with movement patterns, variations & rotations , 2020-11](https://youtu.be/mbtAKsbDz9I?t=220)).
- **Zero injuries vs acceptable injuries.** Smart naturals won't get sudden injuries, and 10 years with zero injuries should be possible ([Serious injuries don't just ＂happen＂, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/9c7O0jjeR5Q); [When Snap City occurs, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/Z35bJjrc_MY?t=316)). But: "pushing the limits will sometimes injure you; that is acceptable" ([Keep Ronnie Coleman's name out of your unworthy hardgainer's mouth, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/5Nhv3cgzrAg?t=442)).
- **Behind-the-head pressing.** 2020: behind-the-neck pressing is bad for the shoulder ([What really happens when you injure your shoulder, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/3qbZ-gpkOmw)). 2021: the behind-the-head snatch-grip press is a valid hypertrophy variation, just never heavy if unconditioned ([FREE Bodybuilding Split (Olympic Weightlifter Physique edition), 2021-10](https://youtu.be/jAnfGqpsK38?t=1360)).
- **Tendon training.** 2020-2024: strength restoration and the JM press target and build tendons ([Strength restoration strategies, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/vijsrI1dkqs); [I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=382)). 2023: direct tendon training is a waste of time for aesthetics ([The Streetlifting MUTANT w/ Steel Cable Tendons (Artem Shirokov), 2023-12](https://youtu.be/M2yqxp4IHXg?t=943)). These are partly reconcilable, since rehab and aesthetics have different goals.
- **Neutral grip.** 2020: neutral-grip DB pressing wrecks his shoulders and neutral curls/pulls can overextend the rotator cuff ([Injury Q&A #1, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/VXwYO2qG9ZY?t=384); [5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 1), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/du7JYCA2pa4?t=620)). Yet he lists neutral grip as a fix for elbow pain on pull-ups ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=10943); [How to do pull-ups to maximize muscle growth and minimize injury risks, 2021-09](https://youtu.be/C4CnYbHCCGo?t=691)).
- **Icing timing.** He says to wait 2-3 h after leg training ([Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 3)： Recovery hacks & supplements, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/UgafGUt-VBc?t=440)), but also to ice ~10-15 min after training ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=1469)). The 2024 phrasing is ambiguous.

## Intensity failure

**Changed over time**

- **Failure on every working set → selective failure.** 2020: every working set goes to failure, "no point not going to failure" ([The hypertrophy series： the importance of going to failure for muscle building, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/UpbamnOFaZw?t=124); [Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/MIHPylz3f7Q?t=300)), though even then compounds kept a rep in the tank ([Rep Goal System (by Steve Shaw of Massive Iron) review, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/LYBdXCcmOO0?t=250)). From 2022: failure on everything misallocates resources, "always training to failure is stupid", proximity is the point; failure only on isolation and upper body ([3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06](https://youtu.be/qrBLykvU_EE?t=188); [The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=503); [How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/z2uzpl_smSg?t=2903); [1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=10175)). Later view: selective.
- **RIR size on lower-body compounds.** 2020-11: exactly 1 RIR, never 2 or more ([The hypertrophy series： applying reps in reserve while minimizing tonnage loss, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/JmowZI5YiAk?t=189)). 2022-2024: 2 RIR on squats/deadlifts/SSB squats, 1-2 RIR on hinges ([𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/yoROLGGUPXU?t=1660); [We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/d1eLAd5WvIA?t=3755); [Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/JW73oft8Q60?t=740)). Later view: 1-2 (often 2).
- **Rest-pause.** 2020-21: skeptical, ranked last, leaks tonnage, a disguised three sets ([5 Ways to shock the muscle (GONE WRONG), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/RqS8AxVE28I?t=697); [Doggcrapp Training review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/A55c7v1yMn4?t=375)). 2023-25: his favourite technique, preferred over drop sets, worth +10-50% hyper-intense volume ([Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/-OYtq2AHGX8?t=1833); [20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/qvWxIzhT1QU?t=696); [10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01](https://youtu.be/waeSP7DBmig?t=160)). Later view: pro rest-pause.
- **Upper rep limit.** 2020-02: 20-35 reps as the upper limit ([Transcendent training review (from an hypertrophy standpoint), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/uTHCzF7Exck?t=760)). 2020-09: ~15 ([How to start doing more volume in your training, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/p6WcFTOBq3s?t=436)). 2022-12: 15-20 extremes ([How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/z2uzpl_smSg?t=757)). 2024: "never 20+", all work 3-15 ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=7914); [Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=2535)). 2025 adds that true failure is reachable at 12-15 ([New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03](https://youtu.be/ACFKXT44BzM?t=1063)).
- **Personal skew from volume to intensity.** 2020-21: he loves volume, doesn't respond well to intensity, calls himself volume-skewed ([Wisconsin method aka Bulgarian light review (from a muscular hypertrophy standpo, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/RaGX9rPQr4k?t=1294); [The Recovery Pot Explained (a complete guide to muscle recuperation), 2021-02](https://youtu.be/p-kR3RfGBHw?t=150)). 2023-24: intensity drives growth and volume is a last resort; "these days intensity" ([Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/7uBT8vp0lNw?t=382); [Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/wBct3Pl8OY4?t=3680)).
- **Hip thrusts.** 2020: never to failure ([5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 1), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/du7JYCA2pa4?t=744)). 2022: failure is safe, as long as ROM isn't cut ([🦍 Get Gorilla Glutes (Best 𝙢𝘼𝙎𝙎 Building Exercises), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/vlnnV8BdWCE?t=845)).
- **Mentzer/HIT tone.** 2020: HIT is a cult ([Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/6sFaB3rAY1A?t=2448)). 2022-24: keep Mentzer's hard-set understanding; Mentzer was right on intensity but went too far ([Mike Mentzer： Mustachioed fraud or Bodybuilding genius? (🆃🅷🅴 🅷🅸, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/lmhW2W2UQto?t=1514); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=14205)).
- **AMRAP.** 2020: he does pull-ups as AMRAPs and likes it ([Program critique #1 (Upper Lower Push Pull), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/np9LdwTPfNs?t=636)). 2021: AMRAPs only for finishers and unweighted calisthenics ([Hypertrophy Q&A #8, 2021-09](https://youtu.be/P89o8FBSWDI?t=232)). 2024: drop AMRAP sets from bodybuilding programs ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=5100)), although bodyweight pull-up AMRAPs still appear in 2023 ([Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/7uBT8vp0lNw?t=447)).

**Contradictions**

- **RIR on compounds: sandbagging or smart?** He keeps 1-2 RIR on squats and hinges ([We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/d1eLAd5WvIA?t=3755); [1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=4770)), yet says leaving strength reps in reserve is a strength-athlete tool and bodybuilders who sandbag "train for strength" ([The Great MOGGING of Bodybuilding： How Strength Came to DOMINATE Fitness, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/GNJkAcgUJ_0?t=5710)), and that progressing 4-6 with RIR "is just sandbagging" ([New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03](https://youtu.be/ACFKXT44BzM?t=563)). The 2025 remark targets low-rep HIT-style work, but the tension isn't resolved.
- **Percentages vs no percentages.** He recommends % of an estimated 1RM over RPE ([The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07](https://youtu.be/8ELQ2XZgpls?t=2320); [No one understands training intensity, 2021-11](https://youtu.be/UrFS3Gs5zh0?t=540)), but also says "no percentages, push every set to failure" ([FREE 4 days Upper Lower sheiko inspired Bodybuilding Program, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/HVD5j7hOobI?t=186)), that he dislikes percentages ([When are you intermediate and what it means programming wise (for bodybuilding), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/y_lPAdWi4sU?t=318)), and that he doesn't know his own 1RM ([The hypertrophy series： volume vs intensity, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/UQguwgxTC9E?t=126)).
- **Heavy/medium/light days.** He dislikes light/heavy days and volume/intensity days ([Upper Lower Light/Heavy 4 days split with mirror Week program review (part. 1), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/niD0UuwTUvg?t=318); [Hypertrophy Q&A #6, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/pvpf7Yuayco?t=106)), but full body "needs heavy, medium and light days for each muscle" ([Fullbody template review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/G7rVTseabFU?t=530)). Possibly split-dependent.
- **Steady vs swinging intensity.** "Steady 85-95% beats swinging between 99% and 60%" ([The hypertrophy series： deloading without wasting tonnage, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/7ZS-mGePFXw?t=480)) vs "intensity can swing (95% one day, 65% the next)" around an 85% average ([How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12](https://youtu.be/z2uzpl_smSg?t=820)).
- **Can intensity exceed 100%?** No; forced reps only shift the window ([Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/6sFaB3rAY1A?t=2510)). Yes, via overloads like high block pulls ([The hypertrophy series： nucleus overload vs junk volume, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/T0QddSpwwdc?t=317)).
- **NO and failure.** NO at ~15% "still reaches muscular failure" ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ZXFj-taKBis?t=64)) vs "never reach failure on NO, always ≥5 reps left" ([☣️ Biohacking Muscle Growth with Nucleus Overload 💪, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/LNggSj0WBd8?t=502)).
- **Meaning of "mechanical failure".** In 2020-21 it is structural breakdown that doesn't count as failure ([The hypertrophy series： the importance of going to failure for muscle building, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/UpbamnOFaZw?t=124); [The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07](https://youtu.be/8ELQ2XZgpls?t=2253)). In 2023 he "defines failure as mechanical failure", meaning stop when body English appears ([SAVAGE PUSH DAY 🔥 (Hypertrophy Log #3), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/0X2PxuT3tuE?t=380)). Elsewhere it also means pump/lactic "artificial" failure ([The hypertrophy series： bypassing muscular endurance thresholds, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/fC5KHhv4_bI?t=64)). This is a terminology clash, not a change of substance.
- **Flies to failure.** Avoid ranges that push flies to mechanical failure; failure there is pointless and risky ([6 days french bodybuilding split review, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/eaXDVkHjsZQ?t=242)) vs flies with loads "to failure and beyond" ([𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐋𝐎𝐃𝐄 your Chest Gains (3 𝐊𝐈𝐋𝐋𝐄𝐑 Pec Ex, 2022-11](https://youtu.be/WKy2C8JoltU?t=696)) and cable flies safe to push to failure ([Push/Pull Pull/Legs Legs/Push 3 days program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/eFhwWirR70o?t=739)).
- **One set vs many.** One-set trainees are lazy ([Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/6sFaB3rAY1A?t=2635)) vs one hard low-rep set can replace three chest exercises with better results ([Analyzing the Rock's ＂Black Adam＂ training program, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/BnzVYV9_IQc?t=190); [The hypertrophy series： the optimal number of sets for muscle growth, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/QL9Dh9CGOBQ?t=260)).
- **Grinding.** Grinding drains and injures; never grind ([Why you should leave reps in the tank (Reps in Reserve), 2020-02](https://youtu.be/QiOh8SF-UxQ?t=128); [The hypertrophy series： mechanical vs muscular fatigue, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/T_ZMmSNmLbs?t=381)) vs grinding is where the muscle works hardest and good lifts let you grind ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=1206); [Why you should STOP doing incline curls, 2023-02](https://youtu.be/CGhPZ9AxBJE?t=696)). Likely compounds vs isolations, but he never states that.
- **Back-off loads.** He uses reduced-weight back-off sets ([Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/-OYtq2AHGX8?t=1957)), but also says he never takes weight off the bar because that is regression ([Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02](https://youtu.be/BJXFeQWGUuY?t=1389)).

## Life philosophy

**Changed over time**

- **Stoicism.** 2020: "the philosophy he most identifies with" day to day, practised without the label ([The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 1), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/PB4CW9A3ytI?t=62); [Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/m1fD0HP6sIg?t=1825)). 2021: "not a Stoic", dropped the *Discourses* and moved to Nietzsche and Jung ([The Next Educated Barbarian Cycle, 2021-10](https://youtu.be/7ddQIjZoujQ?t=62); [How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 1), 2021-08](https://youtu.be/pqJjfS-3XDk)). 2022-23: Stoicism "shames instincts", is a self-imposed tyranny and an Apollonian brake on passionate men ([God is 🅳🅴🅰🅳 and so are you： Mankind's Fall from Grace into a Faithle, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/XVOdLHI85dc?t=2829); [Stoicism： A Philosophy for Idiots, 2023-10](https://youtu.be/YzE7sjeMFCs?t=638)). 2024: still the recommended entry point ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=9867)). Later view: a useful starter philosophy that is critically qualified.
- **Anger and emotion.** 2020: leave aggression at the gym, wrath is a capital sin, master and repress your urges in your 20s ([Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Wrath, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/TX8oBw9wHmU?t=189); [Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=1945)). 2022-24: embrace anger that fuels the will; repressed emotion explodes; emotional concealment is men's #1 problem; the full emotional range is masculine ([Natural Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/eC9Srr3ZygE?t=637); [Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/wBct3Pl8OY4?t=1081); [You are not Guts (The Berserk Trauma), 2023-10](https://youtu.be/SS5uAU1rcEo?t=3927); [Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/fPU3nRIH8sM?t=2251)). Later view: experience and channel emotion rather than suppress it.
