- **Religious identity.** 2020-22: baptised, non-practising Catholic who follows the New Testament and considers himself Christian ([Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/m1fD0HP6sIg?t=1382); [Natural Q&A #7, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/QTHtVBP_36g?t=1596); [Natural Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/eC9Srr3ZygE?t=379)). 2024-25: "not religious but spiritual", agnostic ([POV： Your therapist is a bodybuilder (Jung, ＂Modern Man in Search of a Soul＂), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/D5AUHq98RdY?t=319); [TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=3475); [You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/0O0nG2jLadU?t=761)).
- **Work and passion.** 2020-21: "work is happiness", two weeks off make him miserable, fulfilling work stops feeling like work ([Pull Push Legs 6 days Program Review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/rucwL-SIefg?t=439); [Natural Q&A #7, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/QTHtVBP_36g?t=3033); [The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 17), 2021-04](https://youtu.be/as17cE3iIy0?t=705)). 2022-24: don't seek fulfilment in your job, it is an obligation, and never monetise your passion ([I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/q1XhaAN9M5k?t=815); [TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=7705); [Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/hXx-KDH2p28?t=259)). Self-employment followed a similar path: 2022 he preferred clocking out at 5 PM as an employee ([I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/q1XhaAN9M5k?t=753)); 2023 he would rather work for his audience than the corporate world ([Community post (3 years ago, approx date), 2023-10](https://www.youtube.com/post/Ugkxg1eW6hui9-M4yi84syo-o3tkqihDSK8f)); 2025 he launched paid lessons ([RIP Natural Hypertrophy; Welcome School of Strategy!, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/J9_udWdk6ZM?t=1257)).
- **Nihilism.** 2020: read positively ("since we all die, be at ease with it"; "true nihilism" gives meaning back) ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 2), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/Wz3bs32Qo68?t=188); [The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 16), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/UcD6XAb_1YY?t=377)). 2021-22: nihilism is self-destructive and "the most abject limitation", and atheism as belief in nothing is worse than believing something wrong ([A History of Human Greed & Dark Tournaments (YuYu Hakusho analysis), 2021-08](https://youtu.be/rjWsjscF_y8?t=1019); [NO LIMITS ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Devon Larratt, 2022-07](https://youtu.be/SDVF9vWBQAM?t=2223); [God is 🅳🅴🅰🅳 and so are you： Mankind's Fall from Grace into a Faithle, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/XVOdLHI85dc?t=3144)).
- **Status of the body.** 2020: the body is "the lesser part" and an envelope; "you are not your body" ([The Educated Barbarian： Book of Five Rings analysis (part. 4), 2020-05](https://youtu.be/j2u5TzD5fGg?t=631); [The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 2), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/TMAJzmrQVvc?t=1580)). 2021-23: body and soul are one coin, put the body at the centre, and mind-body dualism is the error ([Baki Hanma wants YOU to love your muscles, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/TPPCu5zBPLk?t=240); [Medieval Lifting Wisdom, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/3W-yE2pgTec?t=2702); [Are you too smart to lift?, 2023-01](https://youtu.be/pBszDfFvoVI?t=190)).
- **Source of morality.** 2021 Stoic reading cycle: virtue is built into nature, immortal and self-renewing ([How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 2), 2021-08](https://youtu.be/2ezr-xUf9v0?t=63); [How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 3), 2021-09](https://youtu.be/Da6d5cecRKA?t=848); [The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 18), 2021-04](https://youtu.be/bpg-vTFQsnA?t=192)). 2022+ Nietzsche cycle: morality is man-made, not innate, and should be questioned and judged by consequences ([💥 This Philosophy has the Power to 𝐃𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐘 the World (Mo, 2022-09](https://youtu.be/S6GCa7_D_hE?t=126); [Disappointed by Zoomers, 2022-07](https://youtu.be/zAh18SRUOLw?t=4164); [Only Fools & Slaves Love Chains： Modern Morality vs Will To Power (Aristocrat Ni, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/DbyjAnMGGAA?t=510)). Already in 2020 he held that good and evil don't exist in nature but are socially useful ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 9), 2020-09](https://youtu.be/24j6eNqmnZ0?t=188)).
- **Casual sex.** 2020-21: serial casual dating is immoral and damages both partners ([Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=1692); [Generation Aesthetics： Zyzz, the Godfather of Terrible Role Models, 2021-12](https://youtu.be/k80R-bpvcRk?t=4026)). 2024: still against hookup culture ([Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/jmOPC_ozpwc?t=1222)), but a woman's casual past doesn't damage her, short fun relationships give experience, and "don't be black and white" ([How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/o40xCjIzl14?t=3946); [How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/o40xCjIzl14?t=7527)).
- **Anti-work sentiment.** 2020: "rat race" talk is cope; a man pulls his weight ([Nether Beast Character Study： De Jesús or Matthew (24_11), 2020-07](https://youtu.be/Vvr512xTfRE?t=2277)). 2022: mass quitting is a pendulum swinging back from Industrial-Revolution exploitation, and hustle culture alienates men ([I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09](https://youtu.be/q1XhaAN9M5k?t=1127); [💥 This Philosophy has the Power to 𝐃𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐘 the World (Mo, 2022-09](https://youtu.be/S6GCa7_D_hE?t=3371); [Bodybuilding is 𝐆𝐀𝐘 ? (𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐃𝐎𝐖, 2022-11](https://youtu.be/ImJqBwLqHcw?t=4436)).

**Contradictions**

- **AI**, in the same 2020 video: AI is "underhyped" because machine knowledge compounds exponentially ([Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=1442)), but AI "only does what its programmers taught it" ([Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=566)).
- **Money:** 2021, he is detached and hasn't looked at a paycheck in years ([Natural Q&A #5, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/xlarSnYhRVc?t=443)). 2024, he cares little about money ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=4297)), yet money "matters enormously" because living costs have exploded ([Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/hXx-KDH2p28?t=132)).
- **Openness or concealment:** be frank and sincere, and say what you mean ([The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 9), 2021-02](https://youtu.be/GJudkSxdp-Q?t=740); [The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 21), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/cTHJUS0maL4?t=751)), against "be a closed book" and hide your views ([Natural Q&A #8, 2021-10](https://youtu.be/ilGY8qFjuxI?t=2079)), plus keep a "secret garden" from your wife ([❤️ Dating Q&A #1： Leaving the friendzone, Facing rejection, Opening up to gi, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/egu7WVtu80I?t=1007)). Partly reconciled by his mask doctrine, which applies to hostile settings.
- **Men showing emotion:** men should cry and express their full emotional range ([What Makes a Man? (Toxic Masculinity & Male Power Fantasy in Grappler Baki), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/sgQD0WIfuvc?t=3293)), while his anecdote and observation say a friend was dumped two days after crying and sad men get cast out ([❤️ How to get a girlfriend – A Feminist Chauvinist's opinion on women, lov, 2021-12](https://youtu.be/0ZZwr3REW5c?t=10822); [You are not Guts (The Berserk Trauma), 2023-10](https://youtu.be/SS5uAU1rcEo?t=3815)). This is descriptive against normative; he never fully reconciles the two.
- **Casual sex in his own life:** he condemns casual sex and says hookups gave him nothing ([Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=1692); [Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/jmOPC_ozpwc?t=1222)), but also says he slept with many women who were in long-distance relationships ([How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/o40xCjIzl14?t=2609)).
  - These are the same idea restated: video-game addiction (2020/2022), health before muscle, obey your own path, love beyond good and evil, individual → collective (three flags), security vs freedom, fatherless society (two flags), kindness requires strength (three flags), biology precedes culture, secular morality vs spirituality, men must cook, fate and worry, science/religion vs his spirituality, fake positivity vs useful negativity, masks, Stoic reading order (Marcus/Epictetus/Seneca vs Seneca/Marcus, which only differ in emphasis).
  - Mindset ranking vs gratitude habit: unrelated.
  - "No one born evil" vs "someone born evil who does good deserves more respect": the second is a hypothetical, so this is mild tension, not a reversal.
  - Casual sex: a partial real refinement, logged under changes.

## Mindset

**Changed over time**

- **Place of the gym in life.** 2020-2022: serious lifting means 8-10 h/week that replaces hobbies and social time ([Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/kh--k3genZA?t=755)). Training should be so central that you "would sooner lose your nails" than stop ([Why you will NEVER have freaky, thick forearms if your wrists are small (Natty o, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/YHm-qSHgGSk?t=946)). Strip other hobbies so lifting is your one hobby ([Medieval Lifting Wisdom, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/3W-yE2pgTec?t=1135)), and hobbyists stay mediocre, so make it a lifestyle ([FOR THE DIFFICULT ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Kyriakos Grizzly, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/ZPBwBrOktgA?t=1393)). 2024 (later view): ~5 h/week with no lifestyle change; don't centre your life on the gym ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=843)). Gymcelling is a net negative ([I was a Gymcel (and it made me miserable), 2024-01](https://youtu.be/lGbT0aT2hOk?t=270)), and the gym won't fix your life by itself ([Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/wBct3Pl8OY4?t=6136)).
- **Rigidity.** 2020-2022: training is rigid, done as planned regardless of feeling, and taking a week off for low motivation is dangerous ([Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03](https://youtu.be/PuIp9cGKMHo?t=602)). Grad-school paper lists where an undone item counted as failure ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=907)). 2024 (later): discipline taken too far is a straitjacket ([I was a Gymcel (and it made me miserable), 2024-01](https://youtu.be/lGbT0aT2hOk?t=825)), planning every day makes you hyper-rigid ([Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/fPU3nRIH8sM?t=7873)), he keeps no rigid time schedule ([Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/wBct3Pl8OY4?t=2857)), and willpower fluctuates ([🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=3531)).
- **Harshness vs positive reinforcement.** 2020-2022: praise breeds stagnation and blame drives growth ([𝐁𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐡𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧： Way of the Ü, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/WdFEEkLfBRc?t=2776)). Lazy people get the mediocre gains they deserve ([Are micro workouts really the future of exercise?, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/1ZgJ8kMFd9s?t=125)). He felt pity, not sympathy, for blackpillers ([Determination vs determinism - A discussion, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/eeK8e2KIvwY?t=64)). 2024 (later): his harsh inner voice turns most people off, and empathy and positive reinforcement work for the majority ([🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=2207)). Pure willpower ideology "creates one hero and breaks nine" ([🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=2771)). Being average and a happy dad bod are fine ([10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/loDNjTHZjG4?t=3404); [🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=3722)).
- **Solitude vs community.** 2020-2022: personal development is lonely and company breeds comfort ([ANIME WORKOUTS - Would Baki's training really make you gain 20lbs of muscle in t, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/ZdcKQXMmmPY?t=313); [JUST TRAIN (A Motivational Call to Arms by the Educated Barbarian X Yuyu Hakusho, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/U_4FtEW5nh0?t=66)). Destroying a weak identity requires isolation ([STORY TIME： How lifting changed my life, 2022-05](https://youtu.be/JNBgBfmTqx8?t=566)). 2023-2024 (later): a man's biggest breakthroughs come among other men and the lone-wolf myth is false ([What Makes a Man? (Toxic Masculinity & Male Power Fantasy in Grappler Baki), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/sgQD0WIfuvc?t=4057)). Monk mode makes most people worse, and his own instinct to isolate never helped him ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=1469)). Seek community ([How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/o40xCjIzl14?t=6064)).
- **Fuel: dysmorphia and self-hatred vs self-love.** 2020: lifting motivation may be an expression of dysmorphia, and you must collaborate with that drive ([Jack Hanma's battle against body dysmorphia in Grappler Baki, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/MuQvx5dNpno?t=89); [Jack Hanma's battle against body dysmorphia in Grappler Baki, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/MuQvx5dNpno?t=230)). 2024 (later): self-hatred as fuel works at first then destroys you; love and acceptance kept him going ([🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=1644)).
- **Optimism.** 2020: "your time will come" is an optimistic mindset that always pays off ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 18), 2020-11](https://youtu.be/xoxYiiTPdIs?t=150)). 2023 (later): "active pessimism" ranks above active optimism, and optimists shatter when they fail ([Become the Hero of Your Own Story (An Essay on Individuality & Helplessness in B, 2023-04](https://youtu.be/Ux-tXsicqIk?t=1888); [Become the Hero of Your Own Story (An Essay on Individuality & Helplessness in B, 2023-04](https://youtu.be/Ux-tXsicqIk?t=3847)).
- **Envy.** 2020: envy can be a lifelong driving force, a sin only when it turns into resentment ([Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Envy, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/zt2-wI7GJ-c?t=63); [Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Envy, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/zt2-wI7GJ-c?t=125)). 2021-2024 (later): envy is resentment that keeps you from working and is "one of the worst sins"; admiration is the useful version ([How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 3), 2021-09](https://youtu.be/Da6d5cecRKA?t=103); [Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/jmOPC_ozpwc?t=10166)).

**Contradictions**

- **PR focus (both 2024).** "Dropping PR culture made him stronger" ([The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1884)) vs "constant PRs keep him in love with the gym" ([This is Peak Bulk (Hypertrophy Log #6), 2024-05](https://youtu.be/l6L6HlGM4F0?t=752)). Possibly 1RM obsession vs rep PRs, but he doesn't say so.
- **Gym failure (both 2020).** Never actually fail, because repeated failures build a loser's mindset ([The hypertrophy series： applying reps in reserve while minimizing tonnage loss, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/JmowZI5YiAk?t=126)) vs a lifter who failed 5 times en route to 300 lb handles misses far better than one who never failed ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 18), 2020-11](https://youtu.be/xoxYiiTPdIs?t=680)).
- **Comparison.** Comparison is the thief of joy; don't compare ([The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 20), 2021-05](https://youtu.be/_pbYAfyNM0c?t=1323); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=1824)) vs comparison and competition (mogging) are healthy motivators ([FOR THE DIFFICULT ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Kyriakos Grizzly, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/ZPBwBrOktgA?t=1009)), and surround yourself with better people ([You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/0O0nG2jLadU?t=8435)).
- **Goals.** Have a clear, detailed goal body ([How to body measurements & discussing my weak points, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/KlSyeS0R9FE?t=190); [The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07](https://youtu.be/8ELQ2XZgpls?t=850)) vs don't start with a definite physique goal, just train and see ([Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/m1fD0HP6sIg?t=2139)).
- **Announcing goals.** Verbalise goals and say them aloud; verbal commitment raises follow-through ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 6), 2020-08](https://youtu.be/J99Xzu8JbqY?t=191); [The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 11), 2020-09](https://youtu.be/JXVJtNrIZ9U?t=540); [5 Secrets of Elite Natural Lifters, 2023-10](https://youtu.be/iU-oYc8fbEM?t=318)) vs don't announce your discipline; loud announcers lack internal willpower ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 17), 2020-11](https://youtu.be/KTYf4E4YcB8?t=600); [The Educated Barbarian： An introduction to Stoicism (Enchiridion analysis part. , 2021-08](https://youtu.be/KelEHl5w8Jk?t=1836)).
- **Motivation's weight.** Motivation is "the most important half", you just need method too ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠ： Jeff Nippard, Eric Bugenhagen, 2022-04](https://youtu.be/GowuEmDClqY?t=4152)) vs motivation is too unreliable to carry you ([Make training fun again, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/0RoULYC_tao?t=63); [Alpha Male Routines are making me 𝐒𝐈𝐂𝐊, 2022-12](https://youtu.be/eWP2m4lLq_0?t=501)).
- **Instinct.** Listen to instinct when a style feels right ([How your childhood & personality can influence your fitness goals & training, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/J608dwN-uqY?t=251)), and drop what you instinctively know isn't needed ([4 days Upper Lower split Program review, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/fSOiGuUPqBc?t=1006)), vs instinctive training is rolling dice and lazy ([Your instinct WILL fail you (or why programming your training is essential), 2021-12](https://youtu.be/PSFqnl_EvSc?t=615); [Your instinct WILL fail you (or why programming your training is essential), 2021-12](https://youtu.be/PSFqnl_EvSc?t=718)).
- **Mirror.** Stop obsessing in the mirror ([Lifting/training with scoliosis, 2021-04](https://youtu.be/FDnJTJkQ9YE?t=688)) vs train in front of mirrors for a "mirror mood boost" ([The Perfect Man： Eugen Sandow (Legends of the Past), 2022-04](https://youtu.be/KtoAImbVZF4?t=1601)).
- **Decisions.** Decide within seven breaths ([The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 10), 2020-09](https://youtu.be/1z494UcRwqo?t=377)) vs he never acts on first instinct and sleeps on decisions ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=11656)).

## Muscle specific

**Changed over time**

- **Ab training: daily high volume → weighted, progressive, a few times a week.** 2020-2022: abs daily, 60-100 leg-raise reps a day, "heavy abs does nothing", train them like calves ([My philosophy regarding abs training, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/rGt7TWcWD60); [READ THE F＊CKING STICKY -  The Best Lifting Advice on 4chan /fit/ (Myths & Minds, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/he2KJeMcoAI?t=1387)). 2023-2024: weighted sit-ups 6-12, 3x8-12 progressive overload instead of daily 4x25, 2-4x/week ([Heavy Duty Arm Day (Hypertrophy Log #1), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/awwJ5sbyz6A?t=506); [Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/-OYtq2AHGX8?t=1455); [Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/JW73oft8Q60?t=193)). The later view is current.
- **Obliques: unnecessary → S-tier side bends and twists.** 2020-2021: twisting work unnecessary; oblique isolation rarely works ([5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 1), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/TD9SB9Bt45o?t=545); [Hypertrophy Q&A #6, 2021-03](https://youtu.be/pvpf7Yuayco?t=1280)). 2023-2024: side bends are S-tier, plus twists and suitcase deadlifts; he admits he wrongly believed lateral flexion was dangerous ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=885); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=6317)).
- **Push/pull balance reversed.** 2020: do more pulling than pushing ([Upper Lower 2 days Program review, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/CFlRdyLiWOo?t=313)). 2024: many reviewees are back-dominant from "pull twice as much as you push" advice and need more front volume ([Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=1335); [So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=2347)).
- **Traps: massive NO → little direct work.** 2020: about 150 shrugs after every pull and the shrug-finisher rule ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 3)： my experience & sports applications, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/2edX06SQDnU?t=314); [Weak point Wednesday： Trapezius, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/IgxJijW3MSQ?t=315)). 2023-2024: RDLs cover the traps; shrugs are redundant free volume ([Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=1446); [1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=5296)).
- **Neck frequency.** 2020: daily NO, then 3x/week ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 3)： my experience & sports applications, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/2edX06SQDnU?t=314); [Weak point Wednesday： Neck, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/EnmFDF2DxAo?t=210)). 2024: 1-2x/week is enough and more than 3-4 is pointless ([BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=3120)). Neck reps went from 8-15 to 10-20 ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ZXFj-taKBis?t=567); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=7959)).
- **Forearm frequency: cautious → "spam them".** 2020: daily forearm NO is risky; start 1x/week ([Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/9M7QVlvFdQY?t=900); [3 days Upper 2 days Lower program review (for an advanced calisthenics guy part., 2020-11](https://youtu.be/D3mJh0ZA5nc?t=1090)). 2023-2024: train like a maniac several times a week, 3-4x/week ([SAVAGE PUSH DAY 🔥 (Hypertrophy Log #3), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/0X2PxuT3tuE?t=63); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=5530); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=3120)).
- **Lateral raise frequency.** 2021-2022: up to 4-5x/week, wherever recoverable ([Hypertrophy Q&A #8, 2021-09](https://youtu.be/P89o8FBSWDI?t=1377); [Hypertrophy Q&A #9, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/9y2s6kyFkPc?t=1000)). 2024: once a week; 2-3x hinders progress ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=5036)).
- **Biceps intensity floor.** 2020-2021: strict 3-7 and 3-6 reps ([FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/o3RTXWAia4A?t=823); [The Smartest Push Pull Legs Routine by Jeff Nippard review, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/Mq2TaHm_ySI?t=1709)). 2023: never below 4-6; stretch curls at 10-15 for tendons and elbow pain ([Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=631); [Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/43F9unmSc_I?t=758)).
- **Pullover reps.** 2020: preferably 5-7 ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ZXFj-taKBis?t=754)). 2024: 6-10 experienced, 8-12 novices ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=4294)).
- **Ribcage-expansion mechanism.** 2021-2022: costal cartilage spreading ([Top 3 most underrated exercises, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/AFK9x4EZh2Q?t=189); [Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06](https://youtu.be/QfHfxLYRu88?t=1571)). 2024: intercostal muscle, which shrinks if you stop ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=6266)).
- **Front-delt isolation.** 2021-2022: not needed after pressing ([Jeff Nippard's Push Pull Legs program review, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/pey1Ni6HPlY?t=190)). 2025: front raises are worthwhile free volume ([10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01](https://youtu.be/waeSP7DBmig?t=570)).
- **Calves heavy vs light.** 2020: "don't train calves heavy" ([6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/2ag0uM9zhs4?t=784)). 2024: progressive overload on two loaded calf raises, with load as the key ([So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/pt4mbNb7NJ0?t=633); [The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02](https://youtu.be/ryWJV6yN3ZE?t=3218)).
- **Triceps isolation for beginners.** In 2020 he grew his arms mostly with biceps work. In 2024 he regrets 7 years without triceps isolation and says beginners should isolate every muscle from the start ([The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Ft039H8jzXU?t=1068)).

**Contradictions**

- **Lower back isolation.** "Deadlifts alone are not enough for the lower back; like the core it needs isolating" ([Tips to combat lower back pain #1, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/IqCdPJopcC4?t=249)) vs. the lower back rarely needs dedicated work; stabilization in squats and pulls is enough ([Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12](https://youtu.be/QLUXXk0OtX4?t=312); [Level up your back, 2022-02](https://youtu.be/dVssxcEh1UQ?t=1347)). Both are 2020, and the latter was restated in 2022.
- **Rear delt volume (2020).** "You can never do enough rear delt work" ([5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08](https://youtu.be/4ORCb_i7MxY?t=684)) vs. rear delts have "a striking diminishing return" and need little work ([2 days Upper (Torso/Arm dominant) split program review, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/87CMjYjX2jY?t=812); [5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/eobG2o3Ww4M?t=562)).
- **Calf loading (2020).** "Don't train calves heavy" ([6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/2ag0uM9zhs4?t=784)) vs. a heavy calf day and loaded stretches ([Weak point Wednesday： Calves, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Qd3RB_agebg?t=253); [Is there a natural limit?, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/-cPcWQqMRC8?t=632)).
- **Side bends (2023).** Barbell and dumbbell side bends train the obliques poorly ([The ULTIMATE Abs Exercises Tier-List (Greek God-tier to Scrawny-tier), 2023-06](https://youtu.be/JSOvpTDcSvA?t=630)) vs. side bends are S-tier with full range ([I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/DAZRYoex8_w?t=885)). The difference may be full range on a hyperextension bench, which he used in 2024 ([BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=6317)).
- **Long-head triceps reps (2023).** It "responds best to higher reps and endurance" ([The Monster Natty that trains EVERY DAY (Geoffrey Verity Schofield), 2023-04](https://youtu.be/aJ1e41y8Na4?t=1070)) vs. it fatigues faster than the biceps, so use 6-12 ([We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/d1eLAd5WvIA?t=2874)).
- **Abs heavy (2022 vs 2023-2024).** A plate for 5-10 reps is a "powerlifting mindset" ([READ THE F＊CKING STICKY -  The Best Lifting Advice on 4chan /fit/ (Myths & Minds, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/he2KJeMcoAI?t=1325)) vs. weighted sit-ups at 6-12 and 6-10 ([Heavy Duty Arm Day (Hypertrophy Log #1), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/awwJ5sbyz6A?t=506); [So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=3840)). This is partly the evolution above.
- **Neck directions.** Train every direction ([Most UNDERRATED Muscle for Aesthetics (TAKE THE NECK PILL), 2022-11](https://youtu.be/1U5cgUdos88?t=823); [Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ZXFj-taKBis?t=567)) vs. he never trains side flexion and says rotation only matters for athletes ([So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11](https://youtu.be/6p2x4kDDjzs?t=1900)).
- **Cheat curls (2020-2021).** A staple that built his biceps ([100 lbs (45 kg) cheat curls for 4, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/AKbcYcq1yUI); [STORY TIME： My entire training history, 2021-08](https://youtu.be/aIjUTEtXOcM?t=1190)) vs. heavy EZ cheat curls are "not the way to big arms" ([Limb dominant vs Torso dominant： does it matter?, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/Tfa-eM5LUV0?t=566)).
- **Ab placement (2020).** Ab isolation belongs on upper days while fresh, though he trains abs on lower days himself ([5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/eobG2o3Ww4M?t=1123)). In 2022 he puts abs after the lower compounds ([Silver Era Aesthetics Program (Steve Reeves Physique Workout), 2022-10](https://youtu.be/g-pqgciOSgE?t=444)).
- **Fat grips.** He knows no one who built big forearms with them ([Fat grips training for forearm hypertrophy, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/m-DWvBP_ncU?t=316)) vs. towels and fat grips grew his forearms best ([3 YEAR RECOMP TRANSFORMATION (From Husky to Jacked) - 50K SPECIAL, 2022-08](https://youtu.be/O9txIDHBBIk?t=850)).

## Natural vs enhanced

**Changed over time**

- **Weight of hormones for naturals.** In 2020 the hormonal profile "matters". He called it the biggest genetic factor for naturals, said small edges compound, and recommended heavy squats and deadlifts partly for their acute T/GH boost ([Improving your hormonal profile naturally： train hard & frequently, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/smAsuyqAQOo); [Improving your hormonal profile naturally： train hard & frequently, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/smAsuyqAQOo?t=188); [Why your Genetics don't matter, 2020-12](https://youtu.be/xCzoFKSPkIc?t=939)). From 2022, normal or slightly low levels are "almost irrelevant", low T doesn't stop progress, the T obsession was imported from PED users, and you shouldn't get tested ([To Vitruvian Physique： Don't do it, bro, 2022-10](https://youtu.be/0xZ2Yl1PUmc?t=697); [YES, You ARE a Better Person if You Stay NATURAL! (Response to Revival Fitness), 2022-01](https://youtu.be/rYxVtz6bqGg?t=2262); [To Vitruvian Physique： Don't do it, bro, 2022-10](https://youtu.be/0xZ2Yl1PUmc?t=128)). The later view is the de-emphasis.
- **Androgen-sensitive muscles as tells.** In 2020 he called upper chest, traps, shoulders and upper back "the most suspicious muscles" and giveaways ([How to spot a fake natty： inability to explain muscle size, 2020-02](https://youtu.be/ghUmr86Es4Y?t=62); [Weak point Wednesday： Trapezius, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/IgxJijW3MSQ)). In 2021 he said they "are not signs of steroids; naturals can develop any muscle" ([Natty or not (.com)： Omar Isuf, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/g0HCTuGYy0o?t=564)). In 2023-2024 he treated them as weak evidence weighed with overall development (overgrown traps and delts vs clear lagging areas) ([The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/Mn34v5Y1d-0?t=631); [Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=1717)). Later view: weak evidence at most.
- **Spotting fakes vs dismissing natty-or-not.** In 2020 he made sign-based content ("in most cases there are visible signs") ([The training principles series： natty lifting, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/dWiMIBlqbuA); [How to spot a fake natty： suspicious muscular rendering & general complexion nas, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/02jRt3ENEEA)). From 2021 he called natty-or-not content harmful, a waste of life, and free publicity for fakes ([Natty or not (.com)： Omar Isuf, 2021-06](https://youtu.be/g0HCTuGYy0o?t=724); [Jeff Nippard is WRONG about Natty or Nots., 2023-08](https://youtu.be/aOk65xuzIPE?t=124); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=1947)). He still analyzed individuals in 2023-2024 ([The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07](https://youtu.be/Mn34v5Y1d-0?t=315)).
- **Framing the steroid debate.** In 2021 he called PED use "cheating, though in pro sports it may not be bad" ([Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/JpSZFxsTyKk?t=1060)). By 2022-2025 the debate is about danger and facts, and calling it cheating is a strawman ([⚰️Putting the FINAL Nail in the Coffin and Laying PED Fanboys to Rest for GO, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/Yqg8LaZNMDA?t=439); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=187)).
- **Attitude to users.** In 2021 he had "no compassion" or pity for users who get sick ([The many lies of PED users (part. 2), 2021-05](https://youtu.be/ncd9mxXViBk?t=2078); [My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/RlnOXG0OjPE?t=1311)). By 2023-2024 he felt pity, not hatred, aimed for empathy over insults, and called users "misguided", not bad people ([What Would You Sacrifice for Gains? (An Essay on Ambition & Selfishness), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/hechG8y7Y1I?t=1390); [🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=2271); [I almost took steroids (Story Time), 2024-04](https://youtu.be/Q5ECkNZYZ58?t=1390)).
- **State of natural bodybuilding.** In 2021: "dead", with natural shows mostly not natural ([Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02](https://youtu.be/JpSZFxsTyKk); [I might not be natural, 2021-08](https://youtu.be/CcKOfe_nznI?t=818)). From 2022 to 2025 it's a "noble natty" movement to build and sell on human potential ([The 10 Commandments of Noble Natties, 2022-01](https://youtu.be/GCc2vcnw3Bs); [10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/loDNjTHZjG4); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=2757)).

**Contradictions**

- **Muscle memory.** One 2020 video says lost size "comes back very fast" ([Nether Beast Character Study： Staying on The Mark (13_22), 2020-10](https://youtu.be/ZTdIkUSgBEs?t=2030)). Another 2020 video says that after 10 years and a full detrain it takes much longer than a year ([How to spot a fake natty： rollercoaster progress, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/tqf2di_v9KY)). In 2024: naturals "regain it quickly" ([Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10](https://youtu.be/c7hl9u3h_s0?t=10681)).
- **Enhanced lifters' volume.** "Enhanced and natural lifters' volumes are not very different" ([Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/A4KNy_uMCRM?t=449)), vs pros doing huge volume that exceeds natural work capacity ([Good arm day Vs Bad arm day, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/RSkzA1l5jlk?t=470); [Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03](https://youtu.be/PuIp9cGKMHo?t=6480)), vs enhanced workouts being easy, with baby weights ([How to spot a fake natty： their training is lazy and yet they grow, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/VdMhm70N_6o?t=230); [💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=881)). Coleman is an exception who "genuinely trained extremely hard" ([Keep Ronnie Coleman's name out of your unworthy hardgainer's mouth, 2021-07](https://youtu.be/5Nhv3cgzrAg?t=380)).
- **Drug response.** The hyper/non-responder idea is "exaggerated", and non-growers are lazy ([The many lies of PED users (part. 1), 2021-05](https://youtu.be/32_wVUEiHQc?t=3954)), vs response is unpredictable, some barely respond ([Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/Cn38kgCdOhw?t=1139)), and some pros coast on an exceptional drug response ([Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=5199)).
- **Does a natural limit exist?** "There is no such thing as a natural limit" ([10 Year Natural Transformation 15-25 (from 110 to 210 lbs), 2020-04](https://youtu.be/yenqGI_FVQ4?t=958)), vs natural limits as the body's "safeguards" ([Sun and Steel： The Book That Changes Lives, 2023-12](https://youtu.be/l2tFBCf8cdg?t=4622)) and "the body has limits" ([💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=2195)). Partly reconciled by his "chronological, not numerical" definition ([Is there a natural limit?, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/-cPcWQqMRC8?t=695)).
- **Advice from enhanced lifters.** "Drug users give bad advice and cannot help naturals grow" ([Fitness influencers are giving you body dysmorphia?! (Response to Geoffrey Verit, 2021-11](https://youtu.be/Tos7dHreF3k?t=610)), vs John Meadows "gave great advice" and honest users can be good role models ([10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/loDNjTHZjG4?t=1833)). Enhanced examples are a blackpill "even when the advice is good" ([Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠⅠ： AthleanX, Kinobody, Scott , 2022-05](https://youtu.be/wNunDhhIvRE?t=3689)).
- **Stigma vs empathy.** Shaming saves lives, and refusing to stigmatize is cowardice ([YES, You ARE a Better Person if You Stay NATURAL! (Response to Revival Fitness), 2022-01](https://youtu.be/rYxVtz6bqGg?t=1949); [10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04](https://youtu.be/loDNjTHZjG4?t=1263)), vs dismissing users as stupid doesn't help, and he aims for empathy ([What Would You Sacrifice for Gains? (An Essay on Ambition & Selfishness), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/hechG8y7Y1I); [🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05](https://youtu.be/qYaWxvA4fKg?t=2271)).
- **Naming names.** In 2020 he said he will "never name anyone" or run a call-out channel ([How to spot a fake natty： rollercoaster progress, 2020-01](https://youtu.be/tqf2di_v9KY)), yet he later named many alleged users ([Fake Merc Character Study (part. 21)： Our bum Hemingway, 2022-07](https://youtu.be/ZzcNdESueDs?t=4141); [Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (VI： Liver King, Alex Eubank, Jujimufu, 2022-12](https://youtu.be/uF-j7u5VLaY?t=504)).
- **PED myonuclei.** PEDs "have been shown to increase myonuclei even without training", and regaining is slightly easier after use ([Nucleus overload guide (part. 1)： What it is & how to implement it, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/T74sR7AIOZc?t=1198); [Reasons to stay natural： you pay PED use with your lifespan, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/woBGrw0JWvo?t=252)), vs steroids don't give lasting muscle via myonuclei "in practice" ([💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01](https://youtu.be/thqDZPgE2kY?t=1323)).

## Nutrition

**Changed over time**

- **His own protein intake:** 2020-11: 120-140 g/day ([Nutrition Q&A #1, 2020-11](https://youtu.be/vC9cKh9tFxs?t=460)). 2021-22: 50-70 g ([Nutrition Q&A #2, 2021-04](https://youtu.be/XASWAdsSu0M?t=637); [Nutrition Q&A #3, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/7Sp526pPxEU?t=816)). 2024: back up to ~100-120 g ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=694); [Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12](https://youtu.be/ZLheQPgEfoA?t=1022)). Throughout he says high protein is unnecessary; the later figure is ~100-120 g.
- **Animal products' share:** 2020-04: calories come "largely from animal products" ([My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/Xx7A1dAAPDo?t=505)). From 2022: mostly carbs and plants, modest animal protein ([🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07](https://youtu.be/gSFUgZ42R1A?t=319); [Full Day of Eating (Lean Bulk), 2023-10](https://youtu.be/TxDUQPe3B0E?t=754)); 2024: meat ≤1x/day ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=4388)).
- **Red meat:** 1 lb/week (2020) ([My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/Xx7A1dAAPDo?t=379)) → beef eliminated (2022) ([🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07](https://youtu.be/gSFUgZ42R1A?t=540)) → beef ~every two months (2024) ([1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09](https://youtu.be/bRKQIOYo2u4?t=651)).
- **Eggs:** 12/day in his early bulks ([My Nightmare Bulk (Story Time), 2023-09](https://youtu.be/XK9KjVP-5Wo?t=817)) → 4-8/week (2020) ([My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/Xx7A1dAAPDo?t=442)) → 4-6/week (2024) ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=884)).
- **Dairy:** first milk only (2020; he still liked goat cheese) ([My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04](https://youtu.be/Xx7A1dAAPDo?t=442)). Then cow and goat cheese went too, over two years (2022) ([🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07](https://youtu.be/gSFUgZ42R1A?t=822)). Butter 1-2x/wk is the only dairy left (2024) ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=1011)).
- **Sugar:** 2021 he restricted sugars except fruit ([The Best/Worst of Reddit Fitness - The Ten Commandments of Lifting, 2021-10](https://youtu.be/THV7B11oalk?t=572)); 2023-24 he eats a sweet croissant breakfast and calls banning sugar too extreme ([Full Day of Eating (Lean Bulk), 2023-10](https://youtu.be/TxDUQPe3B0E?t=63); [Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=187)).
- **Pre-workout food:** 2020 a pre-training meal "mostly psychological" ([Can you modify the bodyfat range in which building muscle is most comfortable?, 2020-08](https://youtu.be/mUAHGlseeyk?t=314)); 2023-24 carb meal 2-3 h before, never train fasted ([The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11](https://youtu.be/SxqjF2oPasg?t=3527); [BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/okm6bZHKHI4?t=8320)).
- **Training share vs diet:** "at least 50%" (2020) ([Supplements are (mostly) useless, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/dgxdlxNZUUs?t=437)) → "80% or more" (2023) ([Stop falling for these Ab Training Myths, 2023-03](https://youtu.be/-izcpmcGs-c?t=191)).
- **Meal prep:** 2021 recipes say to batch-cook rice and keep it 7-15 days ([Bodybuilding cuisine： Idiot proof fried rice recipe, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/vx9XinnXBhc?t=507)). By 2022 he doesn't meal prep ([🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07](https://youtu.be/gSFUgZ42R1A?t=1600)), and in 2024 he says weekly prep wasted food ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=1138)).
- **Garlic dose:** 3-6 cloves/day (2020) ([Raw garlic for insane pumps & a stronger immune system, 2020-03](https://youtu.be/Jd2wr0Qe42I?t=374)) → 1-2 cloves every other day (2023, supplements file) ([My Favorite ＂Anabolic Herbs＂ for Bodybuilding, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/8C3R94M4yNM?t=686)).

**Contradictions**

- **Which training day gets the most carbs.** Lower-body days: 2021 ([Nutrition Q&A #2, 2021-04](https://youtu.be/XASWAdsSu0M?t=2022)) and 2023 (ginger on lower days "when he eats more carbs") ([My Favorite ＂Anabolic Herbs＂ for Bodybuilding, 2023-05](https://youtu.be/8C3R94M4yNM?t=1380)). Upper-body days: 2022 ([Nutrition Q&A #3, 2022-03](https://youtu.be/7Sp526pPxEU?t=315)) and 2024 ([Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03](https://youtu.be/SV5rA-iMHRE?t=315)). The 2024 version is the latest.
- **Surplus vs maintenance for gains.** He says no muscle in a deficit and you must eat until the scale moves ([Why teens SHOULDN'T cut, 2020-07](https://youtu.be/pr6glFcyye0?t=191); [Ectomorphs can NEVER get buff, ripped & strong (Nattyornot.com), 2021-09](https://youtu.be/74XVh8ghvs4?t=506)), but also that maintenance is "all you need for gains" ([Clean foods： illusion or reality?, 2021-01](https://youtu.be/xi9CuNbLd9g?t=439)).
- **Intuitive eating.** He recommends eating by instinct ([Food insecurity/neurotic traits and dieting, 2020-06](https://youtu.be/FWxW69B5_XM?t=251)), yet says relying only on appetite during a recomp backfired on him ([Recomp guide (part. 2)： Who can do it & diet manipulation, 2020-05](https://youtu.be/IeYLu4_hkZY?t=753)).
- **Fried rice fridge life.** 7-9 days ([Bodybuilding cuisine： Idiot proof fried rice recipe, 2021-05](https://youtu.be/vx9XinnXBhc?t=507)) vs 10-15 days ([Bodybuilding cuisine： Dummy proof vegetable medley recipe, 2021-08](https://youtu.be/KARBYsklt2I?t=506)) (different dishes, both 2021).

## Other

**Contradictions**

- **Grappling:** he likes grappling above all and practised judo (2020) ([Natural Q&A #2, 2020-09](https://youtu.be/Zg0oUngwPK4?t=1507)). In 2024 he advises avoiding ground arts like BJJ/judo for street self-defence ([TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09](https://youtu.be/lyj1BFZ85Dg?t=4618)). These are different contexts (preference vs street advice), so the conflict is mild.
- **Weights and fighting speed:** he calls weights making fighters slow a myth ([Bodybuilders can't FIGHT (but martial artists should lift), 2022-01](https://youtu.be/v-F3QHSM2hg?t=499)), but in the same video says big enhanced bodybuilders are slow and gas out ([Bodybuilders can't FIGHT (but martial artists should lift), 2022-01](https://youtu.be/v-F3QHSM2hg?t=1500)). The likely nuance is extreme size vs moderate lifting; he doesn't reconcile them explicitly.
